sa: शुक्ला वदान्या ह्रीमन्त आर्याः पुण्याभिजातयः। अन्योन्यसचिवा राजस्तान् पाहि महतो भयात्॥
en: Coming from noble families, liberal and generous, endued with modesty, honourable, picus they are related to one another by blood, O king. Save them from a grave calamity.

sa: एवमुक्ते सखा तस्य गरुडो विनतात्मजः। दर्शयामास तं प्राह संहृष्टः प्रियकाम्यया॥
en: He having thus said, his friend Garuda, the son of Vinata, came into his view who being pleased, said to him with a desire to do him good.

sa: हते वालिनि सुग्रीवः किष्किन्धा प्रत्यपद्यता तां च तारापतिमुखीं तारां निपतितेश्वराम्॥
en: Bali being thus slain, Sugriva obtained possession of Kishkindha and (the hand of) the widowed Tara also endued with a face lovely as the lord of the stars.

sa: नूनमार्या न जानाति कृच्छ्रे प्राप्तं धनंजयम्। अजातशत्रु कौरव्यं मग्नं दुर्दूतदेविनम्॥
en: Surely my mother-in-law does not know Dhananjaya sorely distressed with sorrow; nor does she know the descendant of Kuru, Ajatashatru, addicted to vicious gambling thus sunk in misery.

sa: यस्या हि कृष्णौ पदवी चरेतां समास्थितावेकरथे समेतौ। न्मनुष्यमात्रः कृपणः कुतोऽन्यः॥
en: Even Indra himself cannot abduct her for whose protection Krishna and Arjuna, riding in the saine chariot, would follow; what to speak of any other weak human beings?

sa: मौर्वीविसृष्टाः स्तनयित्नुघोषा गाण्डीवमुक्तास्त्वतिवेगवन्तः। हस्तं समाहत्य धनंजयस्य भीमाः शब्दं घोरतरं नदन्ति॥
en: The dreadful shafts of Dhananjaya shot from the string of Gandiva and propelled by his arms shoot through the air with grcat force and create a dreadful sound.

sa: नगरं न यथापूर्वं तथा राजनिवेशनम्। शिवाश्चाशिवनि?षां दीप्तां सेवन्ति वै दिशम्॥
en: The town has lost its old appearance as also the palace of the king; jackals too with constant howls are prowling about in every direction which is blazing.

sa: स सर्वानाश्रमान् गत्वा शैब्यया सह भार्यया। पुत्रहेतोः परामाति जगाम भरतर्षभ॥
en: O most exalted of the Bharatas, accompanied by his wife Shaivya he visited all the hermitages in search of his son) and was greatly afflicted for his sake.

sa: किमस्माकं भवेच्छ्रेयः किं कार्यमवशिष्यते। कथं च सुकृतं तत् स्यान्मन्त्रयामोऽद्य यद्धितम्॥
en: Duryodhana said : “What is good for me? What remains to be done? How can we most effectually bring about the good that we shall fix upon today?”

sa: तव चैव हितं राजन् पाण्डवानामथो हितम्। शमे प्रयतमानस्य तव शासनकाक्षिणः॥
en: It will conduce to your good, O king and also to the good of the Pandavas, for you try to establish peace, desirous of ruling as you are.

sa: पुनरुक्तं च वक्ष्यामि यत् कार्यं भूतिमिच्छता। सुहृदा मज्जमानेषु सुहृत्सु व्यसनार्णवे॥
en: I tell you again, according to the policy that ought to be adopt by a well-wisher who wishes the prosperity of a friend sunk into ocean of distress,

sa: परप्रयुक्तः पुरुषो विचेष्टते सूत्रप्रोता दारुमयीव योषा। इमं दृष्ट्वा नियमं पाण्डवस्य मन्ये परं कर्म दैवं मनुष्यात्॥
en: Led by the will of God, a man acts like a wooden doll moved about by a thread. Seeing the sufferings of the son of Pandu I think that the ordinations of the gods have greater force than the exertions of man.

sa: तत्र किं मन्यसे कृष्ण प्राप्तकालमनन्तरम्। कथमर्थाच्च धर्माच्च न हीयेमहि माधव॥
en: What then do you think, O Krishna, to be suitable to the occasion. By what means shall I not deviate from virtue and from worldly good, O Madhava.

sa: पारिबर्ह ददौ कृष्णः पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्। स्त्रियो रत्नानि वासांसि पृथक् पृथगनेकशः॥ ततो विवाहो विधिवद् ववृधे मत्स्यपार्थयोः।
en: Lord Srikrishna made a gift of several maids, various type gems and a pile of garments separately in the form of dowry or invitation to great Pandavas. Then there took place duly the nuptial tie between the Matsya and the Pandu families.

sa: युवा रूपेण सम्पन्नो विद्ययाभिजनेन च। यत् त्वादृशो विकुर्वीत यशस्वी लोकविश्रुतः॥
en: A young man, endued with beauty, with learning and possessing powerful friends, should do only what is conducive to renown and heard and talked about in the world.

sa: गरुड उवाच भगवन् किमवज्ञानाद् वृत्तिः प्रतिहता मम। कामकारवरं दत्त्वा पुनश्चलितवानसि॥
en: Garuda said O lord, for what shortcoming on my part have you, forbidden me my subsistence-having granted me a boon of your own accord you have withheld it.

sa: शुल्कं तु सर्वधर्मज्ञ हयानां चन्द्रवर्चसाम्। एकतः श्यामकर्णानां देयं मह्यं चतुःशतम्॥
en: The dowry is, O you conversant with all virtue, that you should give me four hundred horses like the rays of the moon and having one ear black.

sa: अनयो योऽयमागन्ता पुत्राणां ते दुरात्मनाम्। तदस्य कर्म जानीहि सूतपुत्रस्य दुर्मतेः॥
en: The great calamity, that is about to come on your sons of wicked souls, know that it is the work of this son of Suta of wicked mind.

sa: जयत्सेनश्च काश्यश्च तथा पञ्चनदा नृपाः। क्राथपुत्रश्च दुर्धर्षः पार्वतीयाश्च ये नृपाः॥
en: And Jayatsena and the rulers of Kashi and of the land of the five rivers and the invulnerable son of Kratha and the rulers of the hilly districts.

sa: संसारयति कृत्यानि सर्वत्र विचिकित्सते। चिरं करोति क्षिप्रार्थं स मूढो भरतर्षभ।॥
en: He is a fool who gives out his intended acts, who has doubts in every case and who delays in doing things that ought to be done quickly.

sa: सीते पर्याप्तमेतावत् कृतो भर्तुरनुग्रहः। प्रसादं कुरु तन्वङ्गि क्रियतां परिकर्म ते॥
en: "Sita, you have favoured too much your husband up to this time. O lady of slender form, be now favourably disposed towards me. Let your person be well-dressed.

sa: पाण्डवैनिहतैः संख्ये पुत्रैर्वाऽपि महाबलैः। यद् विन्देथाः सुखं राजंस्तद् ब्रूहि भरतर्षभ॥
en: The Pandavas being killed in battle or your own sons of great strength, describe O great king the feelings that you will experience, O best of the Bharatas.

sa: यस्मात् त्रस्यन्ति भूतानि मृगव्याधान्मृगा इव। सागरान्तामपि महीं लब्वा स परिहीयते॥
en: He, whom all creatures dread as deer fear the hunter, loses it in the end even after acquiring the earth (for his kingdom) having the sea round it.

sa: यदयं कत्थते नित्यं हन्ताहं पाण्डवानिति। नायं कलापि सम्पूर्णा पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: Though he ever says “I shall be the slayer of the son of Pandu", yet he is not even one sixteenth part of these large-hearted sons of Pandu.

sa: स्फीतस्य वृष्णिराष्ट्रस्य भर्ता गोप्ता च माधवः। त्रयाणामपि लोकानां भगवान् प्रपितामहः॥
en: Madhava, too, is the lord and protector of the rising and prosperous kingdom of the Vrishnis; and that divine being is the great grandfather of the three worlds.

sa: पापं कुर्वन् पापकीर्तिः : पापमेवाश्नुते फलम्। पुण्यं कुर्वन् पुण्यकीर्तिः पुण्यमत्यन्तमश्नुते॥
en: A man, who is notoriously sinful by doing sinful acts, gets evil fruits; and one, who is reputed to be virtuous by doing virtuous acts, gains great happiness.

sa: सुवर्णपृष्ठं गाण्डीवं द्रक्ष्यन्ति कुरवो मम। दक्षिणेनाथ वामेन कतरेण स्विदस्यति॥ इति मां सङ्गताः सर्वे तर्कयिष्यन्ति शत्रवः। शोणितोदां रथावर्ती नागनक्रां दुरत्ययाम्। नदी प्रस्कन्दयिष्यामि परलोकप्रवाहिनीम्॥ पाणिपादशिरः पृष्ठबाहुशाखानिरन्तरम्। वनं कुरूणां छेत्स्यामि शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥ जयतः कौरवीं सेनामेकस्य मम धन्विनः। शतं मार्गा भविष्यन्ति पावकस्येव कानने॥ मया चक्रमिवाविद्धं सैन्यं द्रक्ष्यसि केवलम्।
en: The Kurus shall see my Gandiva with back made of gold. The enemies assembled together shall discuss by saying "By which hand of his, right or left, does he discharge arrows." I shall make a terrible river to flow today towards the other world, with blood for its water, the cars for the eddies and the elephants for the sharks. I shall, with arrows of depressed knots, cut off the Kuru forest having hands feet, heads, backs and arms for the branches of the trees. And vanquishing alone the Kuru army with a bow in hand, there will be a hundred roads to me as to fire in the forest. Struck by me, you will see, the army whirling only like a wheel.

sa: स साधु कौन्तेय इतो वासमर्जुन रोचय। संवत्सरमिमं यत्र वसेमाविदिताः परैः॥
en: Therefore, O Arjuna, the son of Kunti, from here make a judicious choice of a place where we may stay one year without being known by our enemies.

sa: शल्य उवाच पूजितं चोपविष्टं तमासने मुनिसत्तमम्। पर्यपृच्छत देवेशः प्रहृष्टो ब्राह्मणर्षमम्॥
en: Shalya said That best among the Rishis being duly worshipped and seated on a seat, the chief of the gods, well pleased, asked that best among the Brahmanas.

sa: तेषां चैवापवर्गाय मार्ग पश्यामि नाण्डज। ततोऽयं जीवितत्यागे दृष्टो मार्गो मयाऽऽत्मनः॥
en: To redeem my pledge I see no means, O you born of an egg; the only way I can see therefore is to cast off my own life.

sa: यन्मां पृच्छसि राजेन्द्र संक्षेपात् प्रब्रवीमि ते। एतत् पापहरं पुण्यं जन्ममृत्युजरापहम्॥
en: What you ask me, O chief among king, I have told you in brief-a subject sacred and sindestroying and capable of rescuing people from birth, death and decrepitude.

sa: ततः प्रयाते दाशार्हे प्रावाद्यन्तैकपुष्कराः। शङ्खाश्च दमिरे तत्र वाद्यान्यन्यानि यानि च॥
en: The scion Dasharha race having set out, there was one continual music of cymbals. The conches began to be played, also all the other instruments that were there.

sa: अहो नाशंससे किञ्चित् पुंस्त्वंक्लीब इवात्मनि। कश्मलेनाभिपन्नोऽसि तेन ते विकृतं मनः॥
en: Alas, you do not evince any manliness in you like an eunuch. You are overpowered by extreme fear; and therefore is your mind swerving from the right path.

sa: समेतं पार्थिवं क्षत्रं दुर्योधनवशानुगम्। तेषां मध्यावतरणं तव कृष्ण न रोचये॥
en: It is not proper for you, O Krishna, to go into the midst of that assembly of Kshatriya rulers of the earth, who follow the lead of Duryodhana.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच आख्यानपञ्चमैर्वेदैर्भूयिष्ठं कथ्यते जनः। तथा चान्ये चतुर्वेदास्त्रिवेदाश्च तथा परे॥
en: Dhritarashtra said By the fifth Veda, called Akhyana, it is declared that the Supreme Soul is identical with the universe; but there are some that recognize only three.

sa: प्रमीयते चास्य प्रजा ह्यकाले सदाविवासं पितरोऽस्य कुर्वते। भीतं प्रपन्नं प्रददाति शत्रवे सेन्द्रा देवाः प्रहरन्त्यस्य वज्रम्॥
en: The gods with Indra will level his thunderbolt on him who makes over a man stricken with fear, who has sought refuse with him, to his enemy. And his children will die untimely deaths and his fathers ever engage themselves in quarrels.

sa: गतेषु च प्रभग्नेषु धार्तराष्ट्रेषु सर्वतः। वनान्निष्क्रम्य गहनाद् बहवः कुरुसैनिकाः॥ भयात् संत्रस्तमनसः समाजग्मुस्ततस्ततः। मुक्तकेशास्त्वदृश्यन्त स्थिताः प्राहालयस्तदा॥
en: While the sons of Dhritarashtra, after being defeated, were going away, a large number of Kuru soldiers, coming out of the deep forest, appeared slowly before Partha, their hearts filled with fear. They stood before him with joined hands and disheveled hair.

sa: मम तात पिता राजन् शान्तनुर्लोकविश्रुतः। तस्याहमेक एवासं पुत्रः पुत्रवतां वरः॥
en: My father, my dear son, was Shantanu, well known in this world, O king. I was his only son at first-of that best among those who had sons.

sa: तस्यां जज्ञे महाबाहुः श्रीमान् कुरुकुलोद्वहः। विचित्रवीर्यो धर्मात्मा कनीयान् मम पार्थिव॥
en: In her was born my younger brother endued with prosperity, of long arms and the supporter of the Kuru race, the virtuous-souled Vichitravirya, O ruler of this eartlı.

sa: एते वा मामहं वैनाननुजानीहि पार्थिव। एतान् हि सर्वान् संरब्धान् नियन्तुमहमुत्सहे॥
en: Let them do it, for I know, O ruler of the earth, the might of these and I can venture to cure all of them of their anger.

sa: तत्राग्निशरणे क्लृप्तमासनं तस्य भानुमत्। आहारादि च सर्वं तत् तथैव प्रत्यवेदयत्॥
en: And in the fire-room the king placed a resplendent seat especially made for him and also all sorts of food and other articles of the same good quality.

sa: यश्च त्वां सततं पश्येत् पुरुषश्चारुहासिनि। एवं सर्वानवद्याङ्गि स चानङ्गवशो भवेत्॥
en: 0 you of sweet smiles, O you of perfectly faultless form, the man who will behold you often and often will surely be subject to that formless deity.

sa: गमिष्याम्यनवद्याङ्गि लोके समवहास्यताम्। सर्वेषां विबुधानां च वक्तव्यः स्यां तथा शुभे॥
en: If, O damsel of faultless proportions, I go away (thus), I shall be the laughing stock of the whole world and an object of ridicule with the celestials.

sa: येन सर्वा दिशो राजन् पिबन्निव निरीक्षते। तस्माद् वक्त्राद् विनिश्चेरुस्तित्तिरास्तस्य पाण्डव॥
en: From the one by which, o king, he looked as if he would absorb (the cardinal points) came forth, O son of Pandu, birds of the Titara species.

sa: अर्थेन तु महाबाहुं वार्ष्णेयं त्वं जिहीर्षसि। अनेन चाप्युपायेन पाण्डवेभ्यो विभेत्स्यसि॥
en: You desire to win the son of Vrishnis to your own side by wealth; and by this means you want to create gull between himself and the Pandavas.

sa: नामानि चैषां वक्ष्यामि यथा प्राधान्यतः शृणु। मातले श्लाध्यमेतद्धि कुलं विष्णुपरिग्रहम्॥
en: I shall describe their names according to their rank; hear, O Matali. This race is much thought of in consequence of the favor which Vishnu shows to it.

sa: कथयामास धर्मात्मा महर्षे श्रूयतामिति॥ मेरुर्नगवरः श्रीमाञ्जाम्बूनदमयः शुभः। तस्य यन्मध्यमं शृङ्गं सर्वदैवतपूजितम्॥ तस्मिन्दिव्या सभा रम्या ब्रह्मणः शतयोजना। तस्यामास्ते सदा देव: पद्मयोनिश्चतुर्मुखः॥
en: Hear, O great ascetic, the foremost of the pious; there is a mountain named Meru, highly picturesque, made of gold and greatly charming. The middle peak is much liked by the celestials, on which is situate the beautiful assemblage hall of Brahmă extending over a hundred leagues. The four-mouthed deity, sprung from lotus, always. reside there.

sa: सुकुमारं महासत्त्वं सर्वभूतहिते रतम्। तं दृष्ट्वा लोकवध्या स हीनरूपा प्रकामिता॥
en: Beholding him of great beauty and prowess, ever engaged in the welfare of all creatures, that ugly one, worthy of being slain by people, was excited with lust.

sa: न च तं जानकी सीता हरि हरिणलोचना। अस्माभिर्बहुधा पृष्टा निवेदयितुमिच्छति॥
en: Nor, albeit questioned by us many a time and oft, dose Janaka's daughter, Sītā, having the eyes of a deer, intend to tell us who the monkey is.

sa: तस्मिन्नस्तमिते चाथ मन्त्रिमन्त्रकोविदैः। पित्र्ये पदे कृतो बाली सुग्रीवो वालिनः पदे॥
en: After the death of Rkṣarāja, the ministers and the counsellors installed Väli at the place of his father and Sugrīva at the place of Vāli (the crown prince).

sa: ततः स कार्मुकी वाणी समरे चाभिवर्धत। लब्धसंज्ञो मुहूर्तेन क्रुद्धस्तस्थौ यथान्तकः॥
en: Then furnished with his bow and holding his shafts, (Ravana) regaining his senses in a short time, increased in energy and stood in the field like the finisher.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे घोरः संग्रामः समपद्यत। रक्षसां वानराणां च यथा देवासुरे पुरा॥
en: In the meantime there commenced a mighty a encounter between the Raksasas and the monkey, like that which took place of yore between the gods and the Asuras.

sa: उपायमेते वक्ष्यन्ति ग्रहणे नात्र संशयः। कृत्स्नाद्भयाज्ज्ञातिभयं सुकष्टं विदितं च नः॥
en: They alone unfold the means of our detection, there is not the least doubt about it. Fear from kinsmen is therefore known as the worst of all fears.

sa: तद्युद्धमभवत्तत्र समेत्यान्योन्यमोजसा। खरराक्षसपुत्रस्य सूनोर्दशरथस्य च॥
en: Then there arose a terrible conflict between the Raksasa Khara's son and Dasaratha's son.

sa: ततस्तु तां पाण्डुरहर्नामालिनी विशालकक्ष्यां गजवाजिभिवृताम्। पुरीमपश्यन्प्लवगाः सराक्षसाः पुरी महेन्द्रस्य यथामरावतीम्॥
en: Thereupon the monkeys and Rākşasas beheld the city abounding in white houses having spacious compartments, filled with elephants and horses and looking like Amarāvati, the capital of Mahendra.

sa: ततो नेष्टमिदं सौम्य यदहं लोकसत्कृतः। ऐश्वर्यमभिजातश्च रिपूणां मूर्ध्नि च स्थितः॥
en: It does not please you, I fancy, O gentle one, that I am honoured of the three worlds, the lord of riches, and the subduer of my foes.

sa: स्त्रियो ज्वलन्तीस्त्रपयोपगूढा निशीथकाले रमणोपगूढाः। ददर्श काश्चित् प्रमदोपगूढा यथा विहंगा विहगोपगूढाः॥
en: At dead of night Hanuman saw some females blazing in beauty affected simultaneously with bashfulness and bliss, on being embraced by their paramours, like birds embracing their mates.

sa: प्रियाप्रियतरं लब्धं यदहं ससुहृज्जनः। सर्वैर्भवद्भिः सहितः प्रीतिं लप्स्ये पुरीं गतः॥
en: Dearer than the dear, I shall attain to, when returning my city, along with you all, I shall enjoy in the company of all my friends and relatives.

sa: तस्य तेन प्रतिज्ञातं सीतायाः परिमार्गणम्। सुग्रीवस्यापि रामेण हरिराज्यं निवेदितुम् ॥
en: And Sugrīva promised that he would undertake the search for Sītă, and Rāma (on his part promised) that he would confer on Sugrīva the kingdom of the monkeys.

sa: रावणो हि महावीर्यो रणेऽ दुतपराक्रमः। त्रैलोक्येनापि संक्रुद्धो दुष्प्रसह्यो न संशयः॥
en: Rāvana is forsooth endowed with mighty energy, and his prowess in battle is wonderful. Without doubt, when enraged, he is incapable of being borne by this triple world.

sa: तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रविष्टा सा प्रजापतिरथाब्रवीत्॥ कुम्भकर्ण महाबाहो वरं वरय यो मतः।
en: Having said, 'So be it,' she entered (within Kumbhakarna's throat); and Prajapati said,' O Kumbhakarma, O mighty-armed one, do you ask for the boon that you would have.

sa: तां दृष्ट्वा नवहेमाभां लोककान्तामिव श्रियम्। जगाम मनसा रामं वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्॥
en: And having scen seen her, gold-hued and conducing to the happiness of the people like to the Goddess of wealth, Hanuman approached Rāma in his mind and said.

sa: मामनिर्जित्य दुर्बुद्धे राक्षसेश्वरपालिताम्। न शक्यं ह्यद्य ते द्रष्टुं पुरीयं वानराधम॥
en: you of perverse understanding, O worst of monkeys, without in the first instance) vanquishing me, you cannot to-day behold this city ruled by the monarch of the Rākşasas.

sa: ज्वालामाली महाबाहो योगी भक्तजनप्रियः। एष धारयते लोकानेष वै सृजते प्रभुः॥ एष संहरते चैव कालो भूत्वा महाबलः। एष यज्ञश्च याज्यश्च चक्रायुधधरो हरिः॥ सर्वदेवमयश्चैव सर्वभूतमयस्तथा। सर्वलोकमयश्चैव सर्वज्ञानमयस्तथा॥
en: O you having long arms, he is encircled by flames, a great devotee and fond devotees, this lord preserve the universe and has created it. And he, gifted with great strength, brought about destruction in the form of Time; and this Hari, with a discus in his hand, is sacrifice and is being worshipped in sacrifices. He is at one with all gods, all beings, all worlds and all knowledge.

sa: प्रयाहि जानामि रणार्दितस्त्वं प्रविश्य रात्रिंचरराज लङ्काम्। आश्वस्य निर्याहि रथी सधन्वी तदा बलं प्रेक्ष्यसि मे रथस्थः॥
en: Go you. I know that you are worn out with fight. Therefore, O king of night-rangers, enter Lankā. Havirg a little respite, do you depart on your car along with your bowmen. Afterwards, mounted on your car, shall you behold my power.

sa: वानरैस्तैर्महाभीमैर्घोररूपा निशाचराः॥ वीर्यादभिहता वृक्षय॑चेष्टन्त रणक्षितौ।
en: The grim-visaged night-rangers were assailed with trees in that field by the terrible monkeys.

sa: शक्या सीतासमा नारी मर्त्यलोके विचिन्वता। न लक्ष्मणसमो भ्राता सचिवः सांपरायिकः॥
en: Seeking in the world (of men), I may light upon a woman like Sītā; but never on a brother, or a helper, or a warrior like to Laksmana.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा तु वरारोहा मणिप्रवरमुत्तमम्। प्रायच्छत् परमोद्विग्ना वाचा मां संदिदेश ह॥
en: Having said this, that best of fair ones gave me the excellent jewel, and wrought up with anxiety, related to me the story of crow (for Rāma's information).

sa: नास्मिनर्थे महाराज त्वं मां प्रियहिते रतम्। कश्चिल्लघुरिवानार्यो दोषतो गन्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: O mighty monarch, for this, you should not, like a frivolous and base one, criminate me that am ever engaged in what is good and dear to you.

sa: तासां निद्रावशत्वाच्च मदनेन विमूर्च्छितम् ॥ पद्मिनीनां प्रसुप्तानां रूपमासीद् यथैव हि।
en: Their beauty, in consequence of their coming under the governance of sleep, and their being bereft of their senses by Madana, resembled that of lotuses in a sleep.

sa: अदृष्ट्वा किं प्रवक्ष्यामि तामहं जनकात्मजाम्। ध्रुवं प्रायमुपासिष्ये कालस्य व्यतिवर्तने ॥
en: And not having seen Janaka's daughter, what shall I answer? The term fixed (by Sugrīva) having been past, certainly meet it is that I should fast to death.

sa: अनधीत्य च शास्त्राणि वृद्धाननुपसेव्य च। न शक्यमीदृशं वक्तुं यदुवाच हरीश्वरः॥
en: Without being conversant with Sastras, and living in the company of old men, none can speak such words as have been uttered by the king of the minkeys.

sa: ततस्तु तां पाण्डुरहर्नामालिनी विशालकक्ष्यां गजवाजिभिवृताम्। पुरीमपश्यन्प्लवगाः सराक्षसाः पुरी महेन्द्रस्य यथामरावतीम्॥
en: Thereupon the monkeys and Rākşasas beheld the city abounding in white houses having spacious compartments, filled with elephants and horses and looking like Amarāvati, the capital of Mahendra.

sa: अयुक्तं निधनं कर्तुं पुत्रस्य जनितुर्मम । घृणामपास्य रामार्थे निहन्यां भ्रातुरात्मजम्॥
en: It is not meet for me to slay the son of my brother, yet, casting off compassion will I for Rama slay him.* *The text has 'brother's son.'

sa: उत्पातान्विविधान्दृष्ट्वा घोरान्बहुविधान्बहून्। विनाशमनुपश्यामि सर्वेषां रक्षसामहम्॥
en: Witnessing various and many dire portents, I perceive the destruction of all the Rākşasas.

sa: निहताः किंकराः सर्वे जम्बुमाली च राक्षसः। अमात्यपुत्रा वीराश्च पश्च सेनाग्रगामिनः॥
en: Slain have been all the servants, as also Jambumālī, and those five generals, the heroic sons of my councillors, and the swelling forces including steeds, elephants and cars.

sa: रावणेन रणे शक्तिः कुद्धेनाशीविषोपमा। मुक्ता शूरस्य भीतस्य लक्ष्मणस्य ममज्ज सा।।३४ न्यपतत्सा महावेगा लक्ष्मणस्य महोरसि। जिह्वेवोरगराजस्य दीप्यमाना महाद्युतिः॥ ततो रावणवेगेन सुदूरमवगाढया। शक्त्या विभिन्नहृदयः पपात भुवि लक्ष्मणः॥
en: But the dart discharged in the encounter by the enraged Rāvana, resembling a venomous serpent, dived into the dauntless and heroic Laks maņa; and (the dart) exceedingly splendid and blazing, possessed of dreadful impetuosity and resembling the tongue of the king of serpents, smote Lakşmaņa in his mighty chest. And with his breast riven by the dart driving deep through the force of Rāvana, Lakşmaņa fell down to the earth.

sa: अर्थसिद्ध्यै हरिश्रेष्ठ गच्छ सौम्य यथासुखम्। समानय च वैदेहीं राघवेण महात्मना॥
en: For compassing your end, go, O foremost of monkeys, O mild one, at yours ease. And bringing to Vaidehī tidings touching the highsouled Rāghava do you meet her.

sa: स मे कपिश्रेष्ठ सलक्ष्मणं प्रियं सयूथपं क्षिप्रमिहोपपादय। चिराय रामं प्रति शोककर्शितां कुरुष्व मां वानरवीर हर्षिताम्॥
en: O best of monkeys do you speedily bring here my dear one along with Lakşmaņa and the lord of monkey hosts. O heroic monkey, do you soon satisfy me, who am stricken with grief in consequence of my long separation from Rāma.

sa: केचिच्छरण्यं शरणं स्म रामं व्रजन्ति केचिद्व्यथिताः पतन्ति। केचिदिशश्च व्यथिताः पतन्ति केचिद्भयार्ता भुवि शेरते स्म ॥
en: Then some sought the shelter of Răma, worthy of being so sought; and some, stricken (with panic), dropped to the earth; and some, suffering (from fear), fled to the carindal points; and some through stress (of apprehension) lay down on the ground.

sa: तत्रापश्यत्स वै कन्यां कृष्णाजिनजटाधराम्। आर्षेण विधिना युक्तां दीप्यन्ती देवतामिव ॥
en: It came to pass that there he saw a damsel wearing a dark deer-skin and matted locks, leading the life of a saint, and flaming like a celestial.

sa: किमाह सीता हनुमंस्तत्त्वतः कथयस्व मे। एतेन खलु जीविष्ये भेषजेनातुरो यथा॥
en: Do you relate to me in sooth, O Hanuman, what Şītā has spoken to you. I shall live by these words, as the sick are cured by medicine.

sa: जहि शत्रुचमूं वीर दर्शयाध पराक्रमम्। भर्तृपिण्डस्य कालोऽयं निर्देष्टुं साधु युध्यताम्॥
en: Do you slay the enemy's force, O hero, and display your prowess. Now has come the time of returning the favours of your master. Do you fight bravely.

sa: चन्द्राभा भूषणाभा च ग्रहाणां ज्वलिता च भा। हरिराक्षससैन्यानि भाजयामास सर्वतः॥
en: The beams of the Moon and the brilliance of the ornaments and the flaming splendour of the planets emblazoned all round the forces of the monkeys and Raksasas.

sa: स्वेच्छया न मया वीर रथोऽयमपवाहितः। भर्तुः स्नेहपरीतेन मयेदं यत्कृतं प्रभो॥
en: I did not, O hero, turn away the car of my own sheer will. What I have done, O lord, had been dictated by my affection for you.

sa: कामं न त्वं समाधेयं पुरंदररथोचितः। युयुत्सुरहमेकाग्रः स्मारये त्वां न शिक्षये॥
en: Worthy of Purandara's car, you ought not to be taught by me. Desirous of encounter and my whole soul bent on fight, I simply remind younot teach you.

sa: अमोघं दर्शनं राम अमोघस्तव संस्तवः। अमोघास्ते भविष्यन्ति भक्तिमन्तो नरा भुवि॥
en: O Rāma, never is fruitless your view and the chanting of your glory. And always successful shall be these persons on earth who shall be devoted to you.

sa: रावणं जहि यक्षेन्द्र दुर्वृत्तं पापचेतसम्। शरणं भव वीराणां यक्षाणां युद्धशालिनाम्॥
en: O foremost of Yakşas, slay the wicked Ravana, set on sin; and do you (thus) become the refuge of those heroic Yakşas, who are carrying on the conflict.

sa: स सौष्ठवोपेतमदीनवादिनः कपेनिशम्याप्रतिमोऽप्रियं वचं। दशाननः कोपविवृत्तलोचनः समादिशत् तस्य वधं महाकपेः॥
en: Hearing the distasteful yet excellent speech of the bold and matchless monkey, the ten-necked one, with his eyes whirling in wrath, ordered the destruction of that mighty monkey.

sa: कोशलो नाम मुदितः स्फीतो जनपदो महान्। निविष्टः सरयूतीरे प्रभूतधनधान्यवान् ॥
en: There is on the banks of the Sarayū a great and flourishing country called Kośala abounding in corn and wealth, in which the inhabitants passed their days pleasantly.

sa: सुभगा किल कौसल्या यस्याः पुत्रोऽभिषेक्ष्यते। यौवराज्येन महता श्वः पुष्येण द्विजोत्तमैः॥
en: Surely Kausalya is of blessed fortune, for tomorrow under Puşya the foremost of the twiceborn ones will install her son as the mighty heir apparent to the empire.

sa: व्यसने कच्चिदाढयस्य दुर्बलस्य च राघव। अर्थं विरागाः पश्यन्ति तवामात्या बहुश्रुताः।५८।।
en: And do your counsellors, o descendant of Raghu, accomplished in various lore, uninfluenced by greed, consider the conduct of both the rich and the poor involved in peril?

sa: ध्रुवमद्य पुरी राम अयोध्याऽऽयुधिनां वर। निष्प्रभा त्वयि निष्क्रान्ते गतचन्द्रव शर्वरी॥
en: Surely, O Rama, O foremost of warriors, on your having come out, the city of Ayodhyā is shorn of its splendour like the night deprived of the moon.

sa: यथा दृष्टिः शरीरस्य नित्यमेव प्रवर्तते। तथा नरेन्द्रो राष्ट्रस्य प्रभवः सत्यधर्मयोः॥
en: As the sight is engaged in the welfare of the body, the king, that fountain of truth and religion, is engaged in compassing the good of the kingdom.

sa: सत्यं दानं तपस्त्यागो मित्रता शौचमार्जवम्। विद्या च गुरुशुश्रूषा ध्रुवाण्येतानि राघवे॥
en: For certain, in Rāghava are truth and charity, and asceticism, and self renunciation, and friendship, and purity, and sincerity, and learning, and the disposition to tend his superiors.

sa: सा त्वमभ्युदये प्राप्ते दह्यमानेव मन्थरे। भविष्यति च कल्याणे किमिदं परितप्यसे॥
en: O Mantharā, you burn (with grief) in this auspicious time. Our good fortune will come (after this in the shape of Bharata's installation); why then do you grieve.

sa: अयुक्तचारं मन्ये त्वां प्राकृतैः सचिवैर्युतः। स्वजनं च जनस्थानं निहतं नावबुध्यसे॥
en: I believe you have no spies, and that your counsellors are common folks, since although Janasthāna with your kinsman is destroyed, yet you take it not to heart.

sa: न कर्ता कस्यचित् कश्चिन्नियोगेनापि चेश्वरः। स्वभावे वर्तते लोकस्तस्य कालः परायणम्॥
en: No one is the lord of another person, and no one leads him to actions. People are subject to their actions of previous existence and Time aids them.

sa: शरणं वः प्रपन्नोऽहं शरण्याशरणं गतः॥ प्रत्याख्यातो हि भद्रं वो वसिष्ठेन महात्मना। यष्टकामो महायज्ञं तदनुज्ञातुमर्हथ ॥
en: I seek protection of you; and I take refuge in you capable of conferring it. Disregarded have I been, good betide you, by the high-souled Vasiştha. I have set my heart upon celebrating a mighty sacrifice: it behove you to command me.

sa: अभ्युत्थितं ततः सूर्यं बालो दृष्ट्वा महावने। फलं चेति जिघृक्षुस्त्वमुत्पत्याभ्युत्पतो दिवम्॥
en: In that mighty forest, you, a child, desirous of eating, seeing the sun risen, and taking on to be a fruit, sprang up and leaped into the sky.

sa: सौमित्रे हर काष्ठानि निर्मथिष्यामि पावकम्। गृध्रराजं दिधक्ष्यामि मत्कृते निधनं गतम्॥
en: O Saumitri, do you bring fuels; I shall produce fire there-with and burn the dead body of this king of birds who has been killed on my account.

sa: प्राप्स्यामि यानद्य गुणान् को मे श्वस्तान् प्रदास्यति। अपक्रमणमेवातः सर्वकामैरहं वृणे॥
en: Who will confer on me the merit to-morrow that I shall reap by going to-day? Therefore, I prefer even the journey to the woods to enjoying comforts here.

sa: चिन्तयन्ती तदा तां तु निवर्तयितुमात्मवान्। क्रोधाविष्टां तु वैदेही काकुत्स्थो बहुसान्त्वयत्॥
en: And Kākutstha having control over his ownself, with a view to dissuade her who was angry and engrossed in anxious thoughts, began to console her in divers way.

sa: स तु देशो विसूर्योऽपि तस्य भासा प्रकाशते। सूर्यलक्ष्म्याभिविज्ञेयस्तपतेव विवस्वता ॥
en: Albeit without the sun, yet through the brightness of the Soma mountain, the land shines forth with all the loveliness and reality of one warmed by the sun.

sa: कन्यया च पितुर्गेहे वनवासः श्रुतो मया। भिक्षिण्याः शमवृत्ताया मम मातुरिहाग्रतः॥
en: I heard, when I was a girl, that an ascetic woman of well-disciplined character, came to my mother and apprised her of my future abode in the forest.

sa: वनवासे हि जानामि दुःखानि बहुधा किल। प्राप्यन्ते नियतं वीर पुरुषैरकृतात्मभिः॥
en: I know, O great hero, that there are many evils incident to living in the forest; but they generally befall those men who have not their senses subdued.

sa: आसितं शयितं भुक्तं सूत रामस्य कीर्तय। जीविष्याम्ययमेतेन ययातिरिव साधुषु ॥
en: Do you, O charioteer, describe to me what Rāma lives on and where he lies down. Hearing this, I shall live, like Yayati in the midst of saints.

sa: सर्वास्त्राणि कृशाश्वस्य पुत्राः परमधार्मिकाः। कौशिकाय पुरा दत्ता यदा राज्यं प्रशासति॥
en: And formerly while the descendant of Kusika was ruling his kingdom, Siva conferred upon him the highly famous sons of Kțśāśva in the shape of all w apons.

sa: ततः कनकपुखैस्तु शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। चिच्छेद रामः संक्रुद्धः खरस्य समरे ध्वजम्॥
en: And uplifting that superior bow, Rāma rushed against Khara. Then with shafts having bent knots and golden feathers, Rāma, wrought up with rage, severed in battle Khara's standard.

sa: एवंवीर्यो महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महायशाः। न रामगमने राजन् संशयं गन्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: Such is the prowess of that highly famous Viśvāmitra possessed of mighty energy. Therefore, O king, it behove you not to hesitate in the matter of Rāma's going.

sa: कल्यमुत्थाय देवानां कृत्वा पूजां यथाविधि। वन्दितव्यो दशरथः पिता मम जनेश्वरः॥
en: Rising from the bed early in the morning, adore the deities, every day, and then bow down to the feet of my father Dasaratha, the lord of men.

sa: यावद्गच्छामि सौमित्रे मृगमानयितुं द्रुतम्। पश्य लक्ष्मण वैदेह्या मृगत्वचि गतां स्पृहाम्॥
en: Look, O Laksmana, Vaidehi is extremely anxious to get the skin of this deer I shall therefore proceed at once, O son of Sumitrā, to catch this deer.

sa: तं श्रुत्वा निनदं भ्रातुः क्रुद्धो वाली महाबलः। निष्पपात सुसंरब्धो भास्करोऽस्ततटादिव॥
en: Hearing the terrible uproar of his brother, the mighty Vāli, highly angered, issued out of his city, like to the Sun from the western shores (where he sets).

sa: नानावृष्टिर्बभूवास्मिन् न दुर्भिक्षः सतां वरे। अनरण्ये महाराजे तस्करो वापि कश्चन॥
en: During the time of that foremost of righteous person, the monarch Anaranya, drought or famine did not occur (in Ayodhyā); nor were there any thieves at that time.

sa: किं न स्मरसि कैकेयि स्मरन्ती वा निगूहसे। यदुच्यमानमात्मार्थं मत्तस्त्वं श्रोतुमिच्छसि॥
en: Do you not remember, O Kaikeyi, or conceal although remembering, wishing to hear from me of the means for your welfare which you had before communicated to me.

sa: नहि ते स्त्रीवधकृते घृणा कार्या नरोत्तम। चातुर्वर्ण्यहितार्थं हि कर्तव्यं राजसूनुना॥
en: Nor should you, O best of men, shrink from slaying a woman; for even this should be accomplished by a prince in the interests of the four orders.

sa: सर्पमाशीविषं बद्ध्वा वस्त्रान्ते नावबुध्यसे। ग्रीवायां प्रतिमुक्तं च कालपाशं न पश्यसि॥
en: Do you not understand that you have tied with cloth a virulent serpent? Do you not see that you have placed around your neck the noose of death?

sa: तस्याहमुत्तरं कालं निवत्स्यामि सुखं वने। तत् प्रतिश्रुतमार्यस्य नैव मिथ्या भविष्यति॥
en: And for his sake I will in future live happily in the woods. (By my doing so), the promise of that high-minded one shall not be rendered null.

sa: तथा ब्रुवति रामे तु जामदग्न्ये प्रतापवान्। रामो दाशरथिः श्रीमांश्चिक्षेप शरमुत्तमम्॥
en: When Jamadagni's son, Rāma, had said this, the puissant and graceful son of Daśaratha, had said this, the puissant and graceful son of Dasaratha shot that excellent arrow.

sa: यावन्न चन्द्रसंकाशं तद् द्रक्ष्यामि शुभाननम्। भ्रातुः पद्मविशालाक्षं न मे शान्तिर्भविष्यति॥
en: And so long as I do not see that face of his fair as the moon, with eyes expansive like lotuses, I shall not attain peace of mind.

sa: बलमात्मनि पश्यन्ती न विशङ्कितुमर्हसि। करिष्यामि तव प्रीतिं सुकृतेनापि ते शपे॥
en: You see the power you wield in me, therefore it behove you not to fear. I will do your pleasure, by my good deeds do I swear this.

sa: तान् भूमौ पतितान् दृष्ट्वा क्षणेनैव महाजवान्। रामस्य च महत्कर्म महांस्त्रासोऽभवन्मम॥
en: Seeing those possessed of great speed, in a moment laid low on the ground, as well as (witnessing) Rāma's mighty deed, great fear has taken possession of me.

sa: सा त्वं धर्मपरा नित्यं दृष्टलोकपरावरा। नार्हसे विप्रियं वक्तुं दुःखितापि सुदुःखितम्॥
en: Ever virtuous, you, that have seen both the virtuous and the vicious, although aggrieved, ought not to say anything unpleasant to me who am weighed down with woe.

sa: सक्ता रुधिरधाराभिः संहत्य परमद्विपाः। प्रचरन्ति पृथक्कीर्णा मेघवर्णास्तरस्विनः॥ ते तत्र पीत्वा पानीयं विमलं चारु शोभनम्। अत्यन्तसुखसंस्पर्श सर्वगन्धसमन्वितम्॥ निवृत्ताः संविगाहन्ते वनानि वनगोचराः।
en: You shall furthermore observe many a quickly moving, infuriated elephant, resembling clouds in hue and with red temporal juice oozing out of their heads, roaming here and there sometimes separately and again in a band. Those mighty elephants, roaming the forest, return to their woody homes, drinking the pleasant, pure and sweet smelling water of Pampā.

sa: अद्य प्राप्ता तपःसिद्धिस्तव संदर्शनान्मया। अद्य मे सफलं जन्म गुरवश्च सुपूजिताः॥
en: Favoured with your presence my asceticism has attained to its consummation. Blessed is my birth, fruitful is my service to my spiritual guides and accomplished is my asceticism.

sa: तास्तु यौवनशालिन्यो रूपवत्यः स्वलंकृताः। उद्यानभूमिमागम्य प्रावृषीव शतदाः॥ गायन्त्यो नृत्यमानाश्च वादयन्त्यस्तु राघव। आमोदं परमं जग्मुर्वराभरणभूषिताः॥ अथ ताश्चारुसर्वाङ्गयो रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि। उद्यानभूमिमागम्य तारा इव धनान्तरे॥ ताः सर्वा गुणसम्पन्ना रूपयौवनसंयुताः। दृष्ट्वा सर्वात्मको वायुरिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: And it came to pass that they endowed with youth, beautiful and like to the lighting in the rainy season, decked in excellent ornaments, coming to their garden were merrily singing and dancing and playing on musical instruments, O Rāghava! And as they perfect in every limb, and unparalleled on earth in beauty, and endowed with all qualities, and furnished with youth and grace, were in the garden, like to stars embossed among clouds, that life of all (the air, beheld them and said.)12-13-14-15

sa: सुजीवं नित्यशस्तस्य यः परैरुपजीव्यते। राम तेन तु दुर्जीवं यः परानुपजीवति॥
en: O Rāma, ever happy is the life of him that others depend upon for subsistence: unhappy is the life of the person that depends upon others for support.

sa: तत्र तां पतितां भूमौ शयानामतथोचिताम्॥ प्रतप्त इव दुःखेन सोऽपश्यज्जगतीपतिः। स वृद्धस्तरुणीं भायां प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसीम्॥ अपापः पापसंकल्पां ददर्श धरणीतले। लतामिव विनिष्कृत्तां पतितां देवतामिव ॥ किंनरीमिव निर्धूतां च्युतामप्सरसं यथा। मायामिव परिभ्रष्टा हरिणीमिव संयताम्॥ करेणुमिव दिग्धेन विद्धां मृगयुना वने। महागज इवारण्ये स्नेहात् परमदुःखिताम्॥ परिमृज्य च पाणिभ्यामभिसंत्रस्तचेतनः। कामी कमलपत्राक्षीमुवाच वनितामिदम्॥
en: There burning with grief, the lord of the earth saw her lying down on the ground in an improper guise. And the sinless aged (monarch) saw on the ground his youthful wife dearer to him than life itself, cherishing an unrighteous intention, like a torn creeper, and lying down like a very goddess, resembling a Kinnari fallen from heaven because of sin, like a fallen Apsarā, like to an illusion spread to take another, and like an ensnared doe, or a she-elephant that has been pierced with an envenomed shaft shot by a hunter. And himself resembling a mighty elephant in the midst of a foremost, the king, exceedingly aggrieved, out of affection, gently passing his hand upon Kaikeyi's person, thus addressed her furnished with eyes resembling lotus' petals.

sa: विष्टिकर्मान्तिकाः सर्वे मार्गशोधकदक्षकाः। प्रस्थापिता मया पूर्व यात्रा च मम रोचते॥
en: I have already despatched beforehand persons serving for love as well as those for money, and layers of roads and their keepers, and I intend setting out now.

sa: दीर्घकालोषितस्तस्मिन् गिरौ गिरिवरप्रियः। वैदेह्याः प्रियमाकाङ्क्षन् स्वं च चित्तं विलोभयन्॥ अथ दाशरथिश्चित्रं चित्रकूटमदर्शयत्। भार्याममरसंकाशः शचीमिव पुरंदरः॥
en: Having spent a long time in that mountain, that lover of hills and woods, Dasaratha's son resembling an immortal, anxious to pleasure Vaidehī as well as to please his own mind, showed the variegated Citrakuța to his wife, like Purandara to Sacī.

sa: यदि मामाश्रमगतं वैदेही नाभिभाषते। पुरः प्रहसिता सीता विनशिष्यामि लक्ष्मण ॥
en: If, O Laksmana, Vaidehi ever precluding her speech with a smile should not speak to me when I arrive at the asylum, I shall give up my life.

sa: चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि सहितस्य त्वया वने। क्षणभूतानि यास्यन्ति शतसंख्यानि चान्यथा॥
en: Remaining with you in the forest the fourteen years will pass away dwindled into a moment, but without you, they shall the proportions of an hundred years. assume

sa: नात्र कश्चिद् यथाभावं प्राणी समतिवर्तते। तेन तस्मिन् न सामर्थ्य प्रेतस्यास्त्यनुशोचतः॥
en: There exists not one in this world that can change one's nature as received. A person lamenting a dead individual, has no power to prevent his own death.

sa: देवतानां प्रतिज्ञाय गङ्गामभ्येत्य पावकः। गर्भं धारय वै देवि देवतानामिदं प्रियम्॥
en: Thereupon giving his promise to the gods, Pavaka* (Fire) approached Ganga, saying, Do you, O Goddess, bear an embryo; for even this is the desire of the deities.

sa: इदं पञ्चाप्सरो नाम तटाकं सार्वकालिकम्। निर्मितं तपसा राम मुनिना माण्डकर्णिना॥
en: This tank goes by the name of Pancāpsara, and is always filled with water. It was made, O Rāma, by the ascetic Măndakarni, by virtue of his asceticism.

sa: तमृषिं द्रष्टुकामोऽस्मि दुःखेनाभ्यागतो भृशम्। जटायुषा मया चैव बहुशोऽधिगतो हि सः॥
en: I was eager to see the saint; and (therefore), with much ado I came to him; and Jatāyu and myself saw that saint many a time and oft.

sa: विदितो ह्येष वृत्तान्तो मम सर्वस्तवानघ। तपसश्च प्रभावेण स्नेहाद् दशरथस्य च।१५।।
en: O sinless one, all this news relating to yourself, has from affection been known to me through the potency of my asceticism, as also that relating to Dasaratha.

sa: त्यक्तभोगस्य मे राजन् वने वन्येन जीवतः। किं कार्यमनुयात्रेण त्यक्तसङ्गस्य सर्वतः॥
en: What O king, have I, that am renouncing everything and am going to dwell in the forest subsisting on what the forest yields, to do with a following?

sa: कृत्येष्वचोदितः पित्रा सर्वस्यान्त:पुरस्य च। गतिश्च शरणं चासीत् स रामोऽद्य प्रवत्स्यति॥
en: That Rāma, who used to serve all the females in all matters even without his father's permission, who was our stay and protector, is going to the forest.

sa: निगृह्य तरसा मृत्युं लोकानां हितकाम्यया। यस्य भ्रात्रा कृतेयं दिक्शरण्या पुण्यकर्मणा॥
en: The righteous Agastya it is who, wishing for the welfare of the worlds, destroying by virtue of his austerities a Daitya resembling Death, has rendered this quarter habitable.

sa: ऊर्ध्वं मासान्न वस्तव्यं वसन् वध्यो भवेन्मम। सिद्धार्थाः संनिवर्तध्वमधिगम्य च मैथिलीम्॥
en: Do not stay longer than a month. If you do, you shall be slain by me. Having attained your end, do you turn back, having met with Maithili.

sa: ते नयन्ति परं तीरं सिद्धान् प्रत्यानयन्ति च। उत्तराः कुरवस्तत्र कृतपुण्यप्रतिश्रयाः।
en: These take the Siddhas to the other shore and bring them back again. There (are seen the northern Kurus, the abode of those that have acquired religious merit.

sa: लङ्का नाम समुद्रस्य मध्ये मम महापुरी। सागरेण परिक्षिप्ता निविष्टा गिरिमूर्धनि॥
en: That great city in the midst of the ocean, Larkā, encircled on all sides by the sea and situated on the summit of a hill, is my capital.

sa: ऐश्वर्यस्य रसज्ञः सन् कामानां चाकरो महान्। नेच्छत्येवानृतं कर्तुं वचनं धर्मगौरवात्॥
en: Knowing every kind of enjoyment, that magnanimous one who has tasted of every luxury, for maintaining the dignity of morality, does not wish to falsify (his father's) word.

sa: तमुवाचात्मवान् रामः प्रीत्या लक्ष्मणमागतम्। काले त्वमागतः सौम्य कासिते मम लक्ष्मण॥
en: Seeing Laksmana arrive there, Rama, having control over his ownself, greatly pleased, spoke to him the following words. "You have arrived, O Laksmana, just when I wanted you."

sa: तान् द्रोणः प्रतिजाग्राह परीप्सन् युधि पाण्डवम्॥ चण्डवातोद्भुतान् मेघान् गिरिरम्बुमुचो यथा।
en: Drona then encountered that division of the Panchalas, from a desire for rescuring the king, like a mountain with slanting masses of raincharged clouds driven by the tempest.

sa: नारायणाय मे पित्रा प्रणम्य विधिपूर्वकम्। उपहारः पुरा दत्तो ब्रह्मरूप उपस्थितः॥
en: Formerly on one occasion, disguised as a Brahmana, Narayana, came to my father; whereupon my father bowing down unto him presented him offerings in due course and from.

sa: यथाप्रतिज्ञं योधानां राधेयः कृतवानपि। कुरूणामथ सर्वेषां कर्णः शत्रुनिषूदनः॥ शर्म वर्म प्रतिष्ठा च जीविताशा च संजय।
en: O Sanjaya, did the son of Radha, that scorcher of foes, keep his vow and did he discharge himself accordingly towards the (hostile) troops? (In fact), he was the bestower of prosperity, the saviour, the refuge and the hopes of the Kurus.

sa: वृकोदरेण राधेयो भारद्वाजेन चार्जुनः। तद् घोरं महदाश्चर्यं सर्वे प्रेक्षन्त सर्वतः॥
en: Radha's son encountered Vrikodara and Arjuna engaged with the son of Bharadvaja. All the soldiers then began to look on those marvelous and terrible encountered from all sides.

sa: राजन् वैकर्तनो भीमं क्रुद्धः क्रुद्धमरिंदमम्। पराक्रान्तं पराक्रम्य विव्याध त्रिंशता शरैः॥
en: O king, the enraged son of Vikartana then pierced with thirty arrows that chastiser of foes viz., Bhimasena who excited with rage, had been putting forth his prowess.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच सैनापत्यं तु सम्प्राप्य कर्णो वैकर्तनस्तदा। तथोक्तश्च स्वयं राज्ञा स्निग्धं भ्रातृसमं वचः॥ योगमाज्ञाप्य सेनानामादित्येऽभ्युदिते तदा। अकरोत् किं महाप्राज्ञास्तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Having attained the generalship of the army and been addressed by the king himself in sweet and brotherly terms and thereupon having ordered the troops to be arranged in battle-array towards the rise of the Sun, relate to me, O Sanjaya, what did the highly intellectual son of Vikartana, Karna, do at that time.

sa: एवमुक्तास्तु ते सर्वे शस्त्रवृष्टीरपातयन्।॥ द्रौणिं प्रति महाराज जलं जलधरा इव।
en: Thus addressed (by Ashvatthama), all of them, O great monarch, began to discharge showers of weapons upon the son of Drona as clouds pour down showers of rain.

sa: पाण्डवाः केकया मत्स्याः पञ्चालाच विशेषतः। संख्ये द्रोणरथं प्राप्य व्यनशन् कालचोदिताः॥
en: Impelled forward by Fate the Pandavas, the Kaikayas, the Matsyas and the Panchalas, O foremost of the regenerate ones, approaching the vicinity of Drona's car, were slaughtered (indiscriminately).

sa: चकार सात्यकी राजन् सूतकर्मातिमानुषम्। अयोधयच यद् द्रोणं रश्मीञ्जग्राह च स्वयम्॥
en: Then, o king, Satyaki achieved a superhuman feat, in as much as he fought on with Drona and held the reins of his horse like his driver simultaneously.

sa: ससत्त्वा गतसत्त्वाश्च प्रभया परया युताः। सजीव इव लक्ष्यन्ते गतसत्त्वा नराधिपाः॥
en: Some (of them) are already deal and some are still alive; and those lords of men whose life is extinct look live on account of their great splendour.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः॥ अक्षौहिण्या परिवृतास्तेऽभ्यधावन् युधिष्ठिरम्।
en: Encircled by an Akshauhini of soldiers Nakula, Sahadeva, Dhristadyumna and Parshata advanced towards Yudhishthira.

sa: शस्त्रप्रभाभिश्च विराजमानं दीपप्रभाभिश्च तदा बलं तत्। भृशं प्रकाशं नृपते बभूव॥
en: And, O king, that army illuminated by the lustre of the weapons, by the splendour of those lamps and by the brilliancy of the ornaments, looked highly resplendent.

sa: संजय उवाच ततः सर्वाणि सैन्यानि हतशिष्टानि यानि वै। सेनागोप्तनथादिश्य पुनर्वृहमकल्पयत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then all the survivors of the slaughtered army (of the Kurus) were, in obedience to the order of their commanders, again drawn up in battle array.

sa: न भीष्मव्यसनं केचिन्नापि द्रोणस्य मारिष। नान्येषां पुरुषव्याघ्र मेनिरे तत्र कौरवाः॥
en: None of the Kauravas, O sire, O foremost of persons, considered the fall of eithe, Bhishma, or Drona, or other warriors to be a loss at the time.

sa: एवं त्वयि समाधाय धर्मराजं नरोत्तमम्। अहमद्य गमिष्यामि सैन्धवस्य वधाय हि॥
en: Now, making over the charge of the very virtuous king Yudhishthira, that best of men to you, I am today going to slaughter the ruler of the Sindhus.

sa: जघान चतुरोऽश्वांश्च तं च विव्याध पञ्चभिः। सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता प्रत्यपायाद् रथान्तरम्॥
en: Then he (Uluka), slaughtered his four horses and pierced himself (Yuyutsu) with five shafts. He (Yuyutsu), being thus fierced by that powerful one (Uluka) went into another car.

sa: बाल्यदिह त्वं त्यजसि वसु वैश्रवणो यथा) अयत्नेनैव राधेय द्रष्टास्यद्य धनजयम्॥
en: Foolishly you are giving away your wealth as if you are Vaisravana, the king of riches. Without any trouble, O son of Radha, you will see Dhananjaya today.

sa: स साश्वं व्यधमचापि रथं हेमपरिष्कृतम्। हृदि विव्याध समरे त्रिंशता सायकैभृशम्॥
en: He consumed the horses of his antagonist and shattered his car of golden effulgence; then he pierced the latter on the centre of his breast with twenty shafts.

sa: विश्वामित्रो जमदग्निर्भरद्वाजोऽथ गौतमः। वसिष्ठः कश्यपोऽत्रिश्च ब्रह्मलोकं निनीषवः॥ सिकताः पृश्नयो गर्गा वालखिल्या मरीचिपाः। भृगवोऽङ्गिरसश्चैव सूक्ष्माश्चान्ये महर्षयः॥
en: They were, Vishvamitra, Jamadagni, Bharadvaja, Goutama, Vasistha, Kasyapa and Atri, the Sikatas, the Prisnis, Garga, the Valikhilyas, the Marichipas, the Vrigus, the Angiras and other mighty sages of subtle forms; these all were desirous of taking Drona to the region of Brahma.

sa: द्विविधं कर्म शूराणां युद्धे जयपराजयौ। तौ चाप्यनित्यौ राधेय वासवस्यापि युध्यतः॥
en: Warriors either meet with victory or defeat in battle. O son of Radha, even these two are uncertain. Even when Vasava himself fights, the case is not otherwise.

sa: तु राज्ञा समादिष्टा भीमसेनं जिघांसवः। अभ्यवर्तन्त संक्रुद्धाः पतङ्गाः पावकं यथा॥
en: Thus commanded by the king those princes, worked up with anger and desirous of killing Bhimasena, proceeded towards him like a swarm of insects, towards a blazing fire.

sa: अपि तस्य शनायाः परिक्लेशस्य माधव। कृष्णायाः शकुयां गन्तुं पदं केशप्रधर्षणे॥
en: O Keshava, shall I not be successful in avenging the wrongs inflicted on Draupadi by her being dragged by the hair, undeserving as she was of such treatment?

sa: रथस्थितोऽग्रतः क्रोशं यानस्यत्यर्जुनः शरान्। रथे क्रोशमतिक्रान्ते तस्य ते नन्ति शात्रवान्॥
en: The arrows which Arjuna discharged standing on his car, fell two miles ahead and pierced and mangled the foe, just when that car came up to the spot.

sa: न ह्याददानं ददृशुः संदधानं च सायकान्। विमुञ्चन्तं च संरम्भादपश्यन्त हतानरीन्॥
en: People could not mark when he took up his arrows, when he ained them and when he discharged them. They only saw his enemies slain by his anger.

sa: रथाश्च मुख्या राजेन्द्र युक्ता वाजिभिरुत्तमैः। आयान्तु पश्चात् सततं मामेव भरतर्षभ॥
en: Let, O lord of kings, the best of horses by yoked to my excellent cars; and let them, O foremost of the Bharata race, follow me without exhaustion.

sa: द्रक्ष्यन्ति समरे योधाः शलभानामिवायतीः॥ अद्य बाणमयं वर्षं सृजतो मम धन्विनः।
en: in battle, will be seen by the sons of Pritha to resemble (thick) flights of locusts. Today, when wielding my bow, I will continue to rain down arrows.

sa: कच्चिद् गाण्डीवजः प्राणस्तथैव भरतर्षभ। मुष्टिश्च ते यथापूर्वं भुजयोश्च बलं तव॥
en: Is everything right with the toughness of the Gandiva, O foremost of the Bharatas? Are your grasp and the prowess of arms, as firm and strong as before?

sa: शक्तिं तां प्रहतां दृष्ट्वा चित्रो गृह्य महागदाम्। प्रतिविन्ध्याय चिक्षेम रुक्मजालविभूषिताम्॥
en: Having seen that arrows, called Shakti, severed into pieces, Chitra took up his powerful mace, that was adorned with a network of gold and threw it against Prativindhya.

sa: रक्षसामधिराजोऽहं दशग्रीवसमो बले॥ तिष्ठ तिष्ठ न मे जीवन् द्रोणपुत्र गमिष्यसि।
en: I am the Emperor of the Rakshasas and equal to the ten-necked (Ravana) in prowess. O son of Drona, wait, wait, you will never escape alive from me.

sa: यद् बलं पाण्डवेयानां वृष्णीनामपि यद् बलम्। क्रियतां सर्वमेवेह निहनिष्यामि सोमकान्॥
en: You may unite together the troops of the Pandavas as well as those of the Vrishnis, yet I will exterminate the Somakas inspite of all their endeavours. arrows

sa: व्यरोचेतां महारङ्गे निस्त्रिंशवरधारिणौ। यथा देवासुरे युद्धे जम्भशक्रौ महाबलौ॥ मण्डलानि ततस्तौ तु विचरन्तौ महारणे। अन्योन्यमभितस्तूर्णं समाजग्मतुराहवे॥
en: Like the most powerful ones, Jambha and Shakra, in the battle between the celestials and the Asuras. Thereupon both the warriors roved about in that dreadful field of battle in circles and speedily approached each other, engaged in combating, in the battle.

sa: पश्य बाह्वबलं मेऽद्य शिक्षितस्य च पश्य मे। एकोऽद्य निहनिषयामि पाण्डवानां महाचमूम॥ कृष्णौ च पुरुष व्याघ्र ततः सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते। नाहत्वा युधि तौ वीरो व्यपयास्ये कथंचन॥
en: You will witness today the tuition I have received in the tactics and stratagems of war also the strength of my arms, truly you can well count upon the extermination of this vast Pandava troops by me alone, as well upon the destruction of those two foremost of men, the two Krishnas. I am determined not to return from the battle-field without putting an end to those two mighty warriors.

sa: विनिःश्वस्य ततः क्रोधात् कृपः शारद्वतो नृप॥ पार्षतं चार्दयामास निश्चेष्टं सर्वमर्मसु।
en: Thereupon, O monarch, Kripa, the son of Sharadvata, sighing heavily with rage, struck the son of Prishata, who had lost all his efforts, in all his vital parts.

sa: तस्य मुष्टिहतस्याजौ पाण्डवेन बलीयसा। सर्वाण्यस्थीनि सहसा प्रापतन् वै पृथक् पृथक्॥
en: All the bones of that one (i.c., the Kalinga prince) thus boxed to death by the powerful Pandava, suddenly fell down on the ground separated from one another.

sa: जहि कर्णं महेष्वासं निशीथे मायया रणे। पार्था द्रोणं वधिष्यन्ति धृष्टद्युम्नपुरोगमाः॥
en: With the help of your illusions do you kill the fierce bowman Karna in this nocturnal fight. The of Pritha headed by Dhristadyumna will slay Drona in battle.

sa: उवाच चाद्याहमहं दुरात्मन् पास्यामि ते शोणितमाजिमध्ये। अथैवमुक्तास्तनयस्तवोग्रां शक्तिं वेगात् प्राहिणोन्मृत्युरूपाम॥
en: He said “O scoundrel, in this fight I will drink your heart's blood." Hearing these words your son threw a death-like dart at Bhima with all his mighty.

sa: ते पाण्डवेयाः समरे राधेयेन पुनः पुनः॥ अभज्यन्त महाराज यतमाना महारथाः।
en: O king, the son of Radha repeatedly broke the ranks of the powerful car-warriors of the Pandavas, though they tried their utmost to worst him in that fight.

sa: धनुर्घोरं रामदत्तं गाण्डीवात् तद् विशिष्यते। त्रिस्सप्तकृत्वः पृथिवी धनुषा येन निर्जिता॥
en: That fierce bow, given away by Rama, is in every way superior to the Gandiva bow; with that bow the entire earth was conquered twenty-one times (by Bhargava).

sa: तथैव धनुरायच्छत् पार्थः शत्रुविनाशनः॥ गाण्डीवं दिव्यकर्मा तद् राजन् दुर्मन्त्रिते तव।
en: So also Pritha's son of godly achievements took up his bow capable of slaughtering the foe, namely the Gandiva; and all this was owing to your crooked policy.

sa: घिग्जीवितमिदं चैव सुहृद्धीनश्च संजय। अद्य चाहं दशोमेतां गतः संजय गर्हिताम्॥
en: O Sanjaya, let there be shame to this my life, who am deprived of friends. Rebuked to iny life, I have been reduced today to this hateful condition.

sa: ततो भूयोऽब्रवीद् देवो देवानिन्द्रपुरोगमान्॥ न हन्यादिति कर्तव्यो न शोको वः कथञ्चन। हतानित्येव जानीत बाणेनानेन तासुरान्॥
en: Thereupon the God once more addressed all the celestials, headed by Indra himself, saying-"Grief should never be felt by you considering that I shall not slaughter the Asuras. Now do you understand that the Asuras have already been slaughtered by this arrow."

sa: यस्य ज्यातलनर्घोष श्रुत्वा भयकरं महत्॥ पाण्डवेयानि सैन्यानि विद्रवन्ति दिशो दश।
en: Hearing the most tremendous and very high twang of his bow-string and the sound of his palms, even the troops of the Pandavas run away in different directions.

sa: पराजिते ततः शूरे दुपदस्यात्मजे प्रभो। व्यद्रवत् पाण्डवी सेना वध्यमाना समन्ततः॥
en: Thereupon, O lord, when the war-like son of Drupada was defeated, the whole army of the Pandavas, being slain on all sides, retreated from the field of battle.

sa: नूनं नाश्रद्दधद् वाक्यमेष मे पुरुषर्षभः॥ स त्वं गोविन्दवाक्यानि मानयस्व जयैषिणः।
en: Indeed, O foremost of men, the preceptor Drona did not believe in the veracity of my assertion; desirous of victory as you are, accept the counsel of Govinda.

sa: शल्यपुत्रस्तु विक्रान्तः सहदेवेन मारिष। हतो रुक्मरथो राजन् भ्राता मातुलजो युधि॥
en: O sire, O monarch, Rukmaratha the son of Shalya, of mighty prowess-that brother (of Shahadeva), being son of the latter's maternal uncle, was slain by Shahadeva in battle.

sa: जघान चतुरश्चाश्वान् सूतं च त्वरितः शरैः। नाराचैरर्करश्म्याभैः कर्ण विव्याध चोरसि॥
en: Quickly did he then slay with his arrows Karna's four steeds and charioteer. He then pierced Karna on the breast with Narachas of the effulgence of solar rays.

sa: पताका काञ्चनी स्रग्वी ध्वजे कर्णस्य संयुगे॥ नृत्यतीव रथोपस्थे श्वसनेन समीरिता।
en: The banners attached to it decked with garlands of flowers and adorned with gold and moved by the wind, seemed to dance on the top of his chariot.

sa: तादृड्न भावी भूतो वा यच्चकार महायशाः॥ द्विपान् द्विपगतांश्चैव हयान् हयगतानपि।
en: Inasmuch as that high-souled warrior then achieved feats whose equals had never before becn achieved or will be achieved in future. Elephants and elephant-riders and horses and horsemen.

sa: सा जघान हयांस्तस्य सारथिं च महारणे। रथं प्रमृद्य वेगेन धरणीमन्वपद्यत॥
en: That mace had smitten his (antagonist's) heroes and the driver of his car in that great battle and then, having smitten his car, fell impetuously upon the ground.

sa: द्रोणास्रेण महाराज वध्यमानाः परे युधि। नात्रसन्त रणे द्रोणात् सत्त्ववन्तो महारथः॥
en: O mighty monarch, the enemies of Drona all mighty car-warriors and possessed of great strength, though thus slaughtered by his arrows, did not shrink in fear from him.

sa: तस्य तं तुमुलं शब्दं श्रुत्वा कुञ्जरकम्पनम्। तावकानां महाराज भयमासीत् सुदारुणम्॥
en: Those loud roars of his, capable of his making an elephant tremble, entering into the car of troops, struck a great panic to their hearts, O mighty monarch.

sa: वितत्य पक्षौ सहसा पतन्तं श्येनं यथैवामुिषलब्धमाजौ॥ अवाकिरद् वृषसेनस्ततस्तं शितैः शरैर्नकुलमुदारवीर्यम्।
en: Vrishasena began raining hosts of sharp arrows upon the mighty Nakula as he advanced straight like a hawk pouncing upon a lump of meat with its wings spread.

sa: ततः शत्रुक्ष्यं कृत्वा समुहान्तं रणे वृषः। पश्वतां धार्तराष्ट्राणां फाल्गुनेन निपातितः॥
en: Thereupon Vrisha (Karna), having brought about an immense slaughter of the opponents in battle, was himself slain by Falguna (Arjuna), whilst the sons of Dhartarashtra were observing it.

sa: हतो राजा हतो राजा भारद्वाजेन मारिष॥ इत्यासीत् सुमहाञ्छब्दः पाण्डुसैन्यस्य भारत।
en: The king is captured, the king is seized by the son of Bharadvaja. Even these were the cries that were then uttered by the Pandava troops, O Bharata.

sa: नाहत्वा सर्वपञ्चालान् कवचस्य विमोक्षणम्। कर्तास्मि समरे कर्म धार्तराष्ट्र हितं तव॥
en: I will not lay down my armour without destroying all the Panchalas; (and), O son of Dhritarashtra, I will perform which acts in battle as will benefit you.

sa: इषुभिः कार्मुकं चास्य चकर्त पुरुषर्षभः। तत् पपात महाराज स्वर्णपृष्ठं महाखनम्॥
en: Then that foremost of men, cut-off the bow of Karna with his arrows; and O mighty monarch, that bow of golden staff, fell down, producing a great sound.

sa: लघुसंघानयोगाभ्यां रथयोश्च रणेन च। मोहयन्तौ मनुष्याणां चढूंषि च मनांसि च॥
en: Confounding the eyes and minds of men with the celerity with which they used their weapons and the sureness of their aims and the motions of their chariot.

sa: त एव सभ्यास्तत्रासन् प्रेक्षकाश्चाभवन् स्म ते। तत्रैषा ग्लहमानानां ध्रुवौ जयपराजयौय॥
en: The troops of both the sides were eager witnesses of that great Yama of battle and defeat and victory of either party depended on them (Karna and Arjuna).

sa: ललाटस्थैस्ततो बाणैः सूतपुत्रो व्यरोचत। नीलोत्पलमयीं मालां धारयन् वै यथा पुरा॥
en: With those shafts struck upon his forehead, the son of Suta, looked beautiful, as he did before while his forehead was encircled with a chaplet of blue lotuses.

sa: व्यश्रूयन्त मिथो भिन्नाः सर्वलोकास्तु मारिष। देवदानवगन्धर्वाः पिशाचोरगराक्षसाः॥ प्रतिपक्षग्रहं चक्रुः कर्णार्जुनसमागमे।
en: Also the whole world was uncertain as to the issue of that fight. The gods, Danavas, the Gandharvas, the Pichachas, the Nagas, the Rakshasas differed in their opinions.

sa: स तनिशम्यैव वचः किरीटी रथं समासाद्य वृकोदरस्य। मुपागतं शातय शीघ्रमेनम्॥
en: When Arjuna, the holder of crown came near the chariot of Bhimasena, heard him and returned, Nakula said to Arjuna, the great warrior "Brother! Kill this Vrishasena immediately.

sa: संजय उवाच हस्तिभिस्तु महामात्रास्तव पुत्रेण चोदिताः। धृष्टद्युम्नं जिघांसन्तः क्रुद्धाः पार्षतमभ्ययुः॥
en: Sanjaya said Having been persuaded by your son, many elephant-warriors, riding upon their elephants and desiring to bring about his destruction, became highly enraged and marched against Dhristadyumna.

sa: निस्संशयं वधः पुंसां स्त्रीणां संशयितो वधः। अतो मामेव धर्मज्ञ प्रस्थापयितुमर्हसि॥
en: It is certain that he will kill a man, but it is doubtful whether he will kill a woman. O virtuously learned man, you ought to send me.

sa: स समर्थोऽपि मोक्षाय शिष्यान् सर्वानचोदयत्। ग्राहं हत्वा मोक्षयध्वं मामिति त्वरयन्निव॥
en: Though quite capable of freeing himself (from the mouth of the alligator), he (Drona) spoke to all his pupils in a hurry, “Kill this alligator and rescue me.”

sa: वासुकिरुवाच जरत्कारो जरत्कारुः स्वसेयमनुजा मम। प्रतिगृह्णीष्व भार्यार्थे मया दत्तां सुमध्यमाम्। त्वदर्थं रक्षिता पूर्वं प्रतीच्छेमां द्विजोत्तम॥
en: Vasuki said: O Jaratkaru, my sister's name is also Jaratkaru. Given as a gift by me, accept this girl of slender waist for your wife. O best of the twice born, I had kept her in reserve for you. Therefore, take her.

sa: पुरा कृतं महेन्द्रस्य वज्रं वृत्रनिबर्हणम्। दशधा शतधा चैव तच्छीर्णं वृत्रमूर्धनि॥
en: The thunder was created by Indra in the days of yore in order to kill Vitra, (but) it broke into a thousand pieces when hurled on Vitra's head.

sa: ईलिनस्तु रथन्तर्यां दुष्यन्ताद्यान् पञ्च पुत्रानजीजनत्॥
en: Ilana begot on his wife, Rathantari, five sons, Dushyanta being the eldest of them.

sa: येन तद् धनुरादाय लक्ष्यं विद्धं महात्मना। सोऽर्जुनो जयतां श्रेष्ठो महाबाणधनुर्धरः॥
en: The illustrious man who had best the bow and shot the mark was Arjuna, that foremost of all victorious warriors and the great wielder of bow and arrows;

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच भगवन् न्याय्यमाहैतं यथावद् धर्मनिश्चयम्। यथाशक्ति यथान्यायं क्रियतेऽयं विधिर्मया॥
en: Yudhishthira said O blessed one, the truth of religion and morality indicated by you are just and proper. I duly observe them to the best of my power.

sa: श्रुत्वा तु वाक्यानि पुरोहितस्य यान्युक्तवान् भारत धर्मराजः। जिज्ञासयैवाथ कुरूत्तमानां द्रव्याण्यनेकान्युपसंजहार॥ फलानि माल्यानि च संस्कृतानि वर्माणि चर्माणि तथाऽऽसनानि। जानि चान्यानि कृषीनिमित्तम्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, O king, having heard from the priest the words of the Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira), he (Drupada), kept ready a large collection of things, such as fruits, sanctified garlands, armours, shields, carpets, kine, ropes, seeds and various other articles and implements of agriculture so that he might ascertain to which order these heroes belonged.

sa: नावसीदन्ति राजानो विप्रवासेषु राघव। प्रजा हि परिपाल्या हि क्षत्रधर्मेण राघव॥
en: The kings, O Raghava, are never tired of living in a foreign land. According to the morality of the Kșatriyas, their greatest duty consists in governing the subjects.

sa: तत उद्यम्य दण्डं स कालदण्डोपमं तदा। जिघांसुः कुपितो विप्रस्तमुवाचाऽथ डुण्डुभः॥
en: Thereupon with the intention of killing it, Ruru raised his staff in anger, A staff like the staff of Death. The Dundubha then said to the angry Brahmana.

sa: योगसक्ता जगत्कृत्स्नमसक्ता विचचार ह। प्रभासस्य तु भार्या सा वसूनामष्टमस्स्य ह॥
en: And an austere ascetic, roamed over the world, having no attraction for the world, She (the sister of Brihaspati) became the wife of the ! eighth Vasu, Prabhasa.

sa: स तु शापवशं प्राप्तः क्रोधपर्याकुलेक्षणः। निर्जगाम पुराद् राजा सहदारः परंतपः॥
en: Thus coming under the influence of that curse, that chastiser of foes, the king with his eyes whirling in anger came out of the city with his wife.

sa: अत्रानुवंशश्लोकौ भवतःभस्त्रा माता पितुः पुत्रो येन जातः स एव सः। भरस्व पुत्रं दुष्यन्त मावमंस्थाः शकुन्तलाम्॥
en: Here are two Slokas, describing the descendants of Bharata. "O Dushyanta, the mother is but a sheath of flesh (within which the son dwells). The son sprung from the father is the father himself. Therefore, cherish your son. Do not insult Shakuntala.

sa: मरीचेः कश्यपः पुत्रः कश्यपस्य सुरासुराः। जज्ञिरे नृपशार्दूल लोकानां प्रभवस्तु सः॥
en: Kashyapa was the son of Marichi and Kashyapa's offspring were the Suras (celestial) and Asuras. O best of kings, therefore, he is the progenitor of all the worlds.

sa: मातुलो भवतः शूरः पुरुजित् कुन्तिवर्धनः। स ते सन्नतिमानेकः स्नेहतः शत्रुसूदनः॥
en: Who is your maternal uncle, that heroic Purujit, the spreader of the Kunti race, that chastiser of foes, is the only one king who is on your side.

sa: यज्ञे विभूतिं तां दृष्ट्वा दुःखामर्षान्वितस्य च। दुर्योधनस्यावहासो भीमेन च सभातले॥
en: The grief and envy of Duryodhana at the sight of the magnificence of the sacrifice; the joking of Bhima at the expense of Duryodhana in the great assembly.

sa: आगतस्तु पुनस्तत्र गङ्गाद्वारं तया सह। परित्यज्य गता साध्वी उलूपी निजमन्दिरम्॥
en: He came with her (Ulupi) back to the region from which the Ganges flowed to the plains, Taking his leave, the chaste Ulupi returned to her own abode.

sa: तत्र मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना जनकस्य सुतां प्रति। अत्रोषितामिनां सीतामानयेयं कथं पुरीम्॥
en: At that time even I was stricken with anxiety regarding Sītā that how I could take her home since she had resided in the house of the Raksasas.

sa: संजयो मुनिकल्पस्तु जज्ञे सुतो गवल्गणात्। सूर्याच्च कुन्तिकन्याया जज्ञे कर्णो महाबलः॥
en: The Suta, Sanjaya, who was like a Rishi, was begot by Gavalgana and the greatly powerful Karna was begot by Surya of Kunti when she was a maid.

sa: ये च दिव्या ऋषिगणा गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्च याः। सुपर्णनागयक्षाश्च दैत्यदानवराक्षसाः॥ सर्व पुष्टं प्रमुदितं सुसंपूर्णमनोरथम्। साधुसाध्विति तैर्देवैत्रिदिवं गतकल्मषम्॥
en: So did all the celestial Rşis, Gandharvas Apsaras, Suparnas, Nagas, Yaksas, demons, Dånavas and Räkşasas. There upon eulogising him the celestials said: Our region is now freed from sins and all here have been delighted and all their desires have been fulfilled.

sa: स्वस्त्यस्तु कुशलं राजनिति तत्र व्यवस्थिताः। तं नृपं नृपशार्दूल प्रेक्षमाणाः परस्परम्॥
en: "O king, let salvation be attained by you without any difficulty.” And O best of king, having said this to the king, they stood looking at one another.

sa: तत्र द्रौपदी भार्यामविन्दन्, स्वविषयं चाभिजग्मुः॥
en: There they obtained Draupadi as their wife and they returned to their own kingdom.

sa: तेषां तु विप्रकारेषु तेषु तेषु महामतिः। मोक्षणे प्रतिकारे च विदुरोऽवहितोऽभवत्॥
en: In all these various persecutions of the Pandavas by the Kurus, the high-souled Vidura was always engaged in counter-acting their evil designs and in saving the persecuted Pandavas.

sa: तस्माच हिडिम्बमन्तरा हत्वा एकचक्रां गताः॥
en: After this Hidimba was killed and they then went to a place, called Ekachakra.

sa: अजस्रं निपतत्स्वग्नौ नागेषु भृशदुःखितः। अल्पशेषपरीवारो वासुकिः पर्यतप्यत॥ कश्मलं चाविशद् घोरं वासुकिं पन्नगोत्तमम्। स घूर्णमानहृदयो भगिनीमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Here did Vasuki become exceedingly sorry, seeing that the snakes were continually falling into the fire and that his race had been reduced to only a few. That best of the snakes were confounded with grief and thus spoke to his sister,

sa: हिडिम्बायां च भीमेन वने जज्ञे घटोत्कचः। शिखण्डी दुपदाज्जज्ञे कन्या पुत्रत्वमागता॥
en: Bhima begot a son in the forest on Hidimba, named Ghatotkacha. Drupada gave birth to a daughter also, named Shikhandini and she was transformed into a male child.

sa: तस्मिंस्तथा ब्रुवाणे तु राक्षसः प्रहसन्निव। प्रत्युवाच नरश्रेष्ठं दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि दुर्मते॥
en: He having said this, the Rākṣasa, laughing aloud, replied to that foremost of men:-Your understanding is bewildered. By the influence of destiny you have come under my control.

sa: इतिहासपुराणानामुन्मेषं निर्मितं च यत्। भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च त्रिविधं कालसंज्ञितम्॥
en: And a compilation of the Puranas and the history which has been composed by me and named after, the three divisions of time, namely, Past, Present and Future.

sa: भीम उवाच उदासीनो निरीक्षस्व न कार्यः समभ्रमस्त्वया। न जात्वयं पुनर्जीवेन्मबाह्वन्तरमागतः॥
en: Bhima said: Look on this combat with unconcern. You need not take part in it. When he has come to my clutches, he will not escape with life.

sa: यदोस्तु यादवा जातास्तुर्वसोर्यवनाः स्मृताः। दुह्योः सुतास्तु वै भोजा अनोस्तु म्लेच्छजातयः॥
en: The son of Yadu are known as the Yadavas, those of Turvasu as the Yavanas, those of Druhyu as the Bhojas and those of Anu as the Mlecchas,

sa: अनुसार्यमाणा बहुभी रक्षिभिर्भरतर्षभ। ते तस्यावसथे लोखं दस्यवः कुरुसत्तम॥ निधाय च भयाल्लीनास्तत्रैवानागते बले। तेषु लीनेष्वथो शीघ्रं ततस्तद् रक्षिणां बलम्॥ आजगाम ततोऽपश्यंस्तमृषि तस्करानुगाः। तमपृच्छंस्ततो राजंस्तथावृत्तं तपोधनम्॥ कतमेन पथा याता दस्यवो द्विजसत्तम। तेन गच्छामहे ब्रह्मन् यथा शीघ्रतरं वयम्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, they were pursued by many guards-men. O best of the Kuru race, the thieves, entering that hermitage, hid their booty there. Before the force (guardsmen) came up, they too hid themselves in fear. But as soon as they had concealed themselves, the guards in pursuit came to the spot. O king, the pursuers of the thieves saw the ascetic sitting in that state; and they asked him, "O excellent Brahmana, which way the thieves have gone? O Brahmana, point them to us, so that we may follow them without loss of time.”

sa: अर्जुन उवाच मा मां नरेन्द्र त्वमधर्मभाज कृथा न धर्मोऽयमशिष्टदृष्टः। भवान् निवेश्यः प्रथमं ततोऽयं भीमो महाबाहुरचिन्त्यकर्मा॥
en: Arjuna said: O king, do not hurl me into sin your command is not in consonance with the precepts of virtue. That is the path followed by the sinful. You should marry her first then the mighty armed Bhima of inconceivable feats.

sa: एतावान् पुरुषस्तात कृतं यस्मिन् न नश्यति। यावच्च कुर्यादन्योऽस्य कुर्यादभ्यधिकं ततः॥
en: O child, he is truly a man who pays back the benefit received. Such an act is never destroyed. One should do more (good) than others do him.

sa: शप्तोऽसि मम पुत्रेण यतो भव महीपते॥ तक्षकस्त्वां महाराज तेजसाऽसौ दहिष्यति।
en: (Saying in the words of his preceptor) “O king, you have been cursed by my son. Takshaka will burn you with his poison. O great king, be careful.

sa: तस्य पूर्वं शिरो ग्रस्तं पुच्छमस्य निगीर्यमाणा साक्रामत् सुतं नागी मुमुक्षया॥
en: She first swallowed his head and then she began to swallow his tail; in that state she then attempted to save her son and rose to the sky.

sa: अष्टादश समाजग्मुरक्षौहिण्यो युयुत्सया। तन्महादारुणं युद्धमहान्यष्टादशाभवत्॥
en: Eighteen Akshauhinis of soldiers assembled to fight and the battle raised for eighteen days.

sa: ततस्तु भीमोऽद्भुतभीमकर्मा महाबलो वज्रसमानसारः। उत्पाट्य दोर्थ्यां दुममेकबीरो निष्पत्रयामास यथा गजेन्द्रः॥
en: Then the powerful Bhima of extraordinary deeds, possessing the strength of thunder, tore up a large tree like an elephant and then desisted in of its all leaves.

sa: अभिवाद्य ततः सा तं प्राक्रीडदृषिसंनिधौ। अपोवाह च वासोऽस्या मारुतः शशिसंनिभम्॥
en: Having saluted the Rishi, she then began to sport near him. At this very time Maruta robbed of her cloth, which was as white as the moon (light.)

sa: तथेति सम्प्रतिश्रुत्य बीभत्सुः स कृताञ्जलिः। जग्राह परमास्त्रं तदाह चैनं पुनर्गुरुः। भविता त्वत्समो नान्यः पुमाँल्लोके धनुर्धरः॥
en: Bibhatsa (Arjuna) with joined hands promised to do as he was bidden and he received the great weapon. The preceptor then spoke to him again thus, “None will ever become a superior bowman to you. You will be invincible and greatly illustrious.

sa: मेनके तव भारोऽयं विश्वामित्र: सुमध्यमे। शंसितात्मा सुदुर्धर्ष उग्रे तपसि वर्तते॥
en: O Menaka, O slender-waisted girl, it is your business. You must see Vishvamitra, whose soul is rapt in contemplation and who is deeply engaged in the austere penances.

sa: एवमेते हि जानन्ति कुले जाता मनस्विनः। कश्चित् कदाचिदेतेषां भवेच्छ्रेष्ठो जनार्दन॥
en: O Janardana, these intelligent and powerful men born in our race think that one amongst them will at one time become the foremost man amongst all the Kshatriyas.

sa: स ददर्श तदा कन्यां दाशानां देवरूपिणीम्। तामपृच्छत् स दृष्ट्वैव कन्याममितलोचनाम्॥
en: Being desirous of finding out its cause, he wandered about hither and thither; and (at last) he saw a maiden of celestial beauty, belonging to the fishermen class.

sa: प्रदानमपि कन्यायाः पशुवत् कोऽनुमन्यते। विक्रयं चाप्यपत्यस्य कः कुर्यात् पुरुषो भुवि॥
en: Who also would approved of accepting a bride in gift as if she were an animal? What man again is there on earth who would sell his offsprings?

sa: एवमुक्तो महावृक्षं लवणः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः। शत्रुघ्नोरसि चिक्षेप स च तं शतधाच्छिनत्॥
en: Being beside himself with ire on hearing those words of Śatrughna, Lavaņa threw a huge tree against his breast. And ſatrughna too sundered it into a hundred pieces.

sa: तस्मै स कुरुमुख्याय यथावत् परिपृच्छते। वरं शशंस कन्यां तामुद्दिश्य भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, that foremost of the Kurus asked him all about it and he then heard from him about the pledge regarding the maiden.

sa: ततस्तैः संविदं कृत्वा यथावन्मधुसूदनः। निवर्त्य च तथा कृच्छ्रात् पापडवान् सपदानुगान्॥
en: After duly making an appointment (for again coming to Indraprastha) and after preventing the Pandavas with great deal of difficulty from following him the slayer of Madhu (Krishna).

sa: यथावयः समागम्य भ्रातृभिः सह पाण्डवः। सत्कृत्य पूजयित्वा च विसर्सज नराधिपान्॥
en: The Pandava (Yudhishthira) with his brothers came to the kings (who had come to Indraprastha). Entertaining and worshipping them each according to his age, he sent them away.

sa: स मां निराकारमिव प्रहसन्निदमब्रवीत्। अकृतेयं तव प्रज्ञा ब्रह्मन् नातिसमञ्जसा॥ यदात्थ मां त्वं प्रसभं सखा तेऽहमिति द्विज। संगतानीह जीर्यन्ति कालेन परिजीर्यतः॥
en: But Drupada, laughing in derision, cast me off as if I were a vulgar fellow; and he said, “O Brahmana, your intelligence is hardly of high order. As coming to me on a sudden you say are my friend. O dull-minded man, great kings can never be friends with such luckless and indigent fellow like you.

sa: तथेत्युक्ता त्वम्बिकया भीष्ममामन्त्र्य सुव्रता। वनं ययौ सत्यवती स्नुषाभ्यां सह भारत॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, having said this to Ambika and taking the permission of Bhishma, Satyavati of excellent vows went to the forest with her daughter-in-law.

sa: अथ तद् वनमाजग्मुः कदाचिद् भरतर्षभ। पृथ्वाद्या वसवः सर्वे देवा देवर्षिसेवितम्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, once on a time came to that forest adored by the celestials Rishis, all the celestial Vasus, Prithu being at then head.

sa: एवं च मामुपास्थाय कस्माच्च विधिनार्हणाम्। प्रतीतां नानुगृहणीत कार्य किं वास्मदागमे॥
en: Though you have arrived by such an improper way, why do you not accept the worship, I offer to you? What is your object in coming to me?

sa: परं मन्त्रबलं यत्ते तद्दर्शय यतस्व च। न्यग्रोधमेनं धक्ष्यामि पश्यतस्ते द्विजोत्तम॥
en: O best of Brahmanas, I burn this banian tree in your sight. Try your best; and show me your skill in Mantras of which you have just spoken.

sa: ततः क्षुरप्रेण सुसंशितेन सुवर्णपुड्वेन हुताग्निवर्चसा। श्रिया ज्वलन्तं ध्वजमुन्ममाथ महारथस्याधिस्थेः किरीटी॥
en: With that keen, gold-winged razor, headed arrow effulgent like fire, fed with libations of clarified butter the diadem-decked Arjuna cutoff that standard of Adhiratha's son, the great car-warrior.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच आचार्यपुत्रो मानार्हो बलवांश्चापि संजय। प्रीतिधनंजये चास्य प्रियश्चापि महात्मनः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said The son of the preceptor is, O Sanjaya, worthy of honour and possessed of prowess; he loved Dhananjaya and enjoys the love of that high-souled warrior.

sa: अनामयं तन्महदुद्यत् यशो वाचो विकारं कवयो वदन्ति। यस्मिन् जगत् सर्वमिदं प्रतिष्ठितं ये तद् विदुरमृतास्ते भवन्ति॥
en: Having no duality, it is manifest in the form of the universe. Poets speak of it as having no change but in the language and form used for its description. That on which all this world stands-those who know this become immortal.

sa: अदत्तानुनयो युद्धे यदि त्वं पितृभिर्मम। करिष्यामि तवातिथ्यं प्रहर प्रहरामि च॥
en: Although my sires did not teach you in battle, I, however, shall do the duties of hospitality to you. Do you strike me, for I shall strike you.

sa: गतः शुक्रत्वमुशना देवदेवप्रसादनात्। देवीं स्तुत्वा तु गगने मोदते यशसा वृतः॥
en: Ushanas became Shukra by having pleased the god of gods. Indeed, by singing the praises of the goddess (Uma), he sports in the sky, in the great effulgence.

sa: एतत् तु नापरे चक्रुरपरे जातु साधवः। साधूनां पुनराचारो गरीयान् धर्मलक्षणः॥
en: Others who are righteous have not acted thus. Others maintain that the conduct of the righteous should ever be considered as the foremost evidence of duty or morality.

sa: लोकपालाश्च लोकाच नक्षत्राणि दिशो दश। नभश्चन्द्रश्च सूर्यश्च त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: The rulers of the several worlds, those worlds themselves, the steller-conjunctions, the ten points of horizon, the firmament, the moon and the sun are all established in you.

sa: अभिशस्तं प्रपश्यन्ति दरिद्रं पावतः स्थितम्। दरिद्रं पातकं लोके न तच्छंसितुमर्हति॥
en: It is seen that a poor man, even when he stands hard by, is accused falsely. Poverty is a sin. You should not, therefore, speak high of poverty.

sa: अध्येतव्या त्रयी नित्यं भवितव्यं विपश्चिता। सर्वथा धनमाहार्यं यष्टव्यं चापि यत्नतः॥
en: The learned man have decreed that kings should live, reciting every day the three Vedas, seeking to acquire wealth, and carefully celebrating sacrifices with the wealth thus acquired.

sa: वर्षासु दीपदानेन शशिवच्छोभते नरः॥ तमोरूपं न तस्यास्ति दीपकं यः प्रयच्छति।
en: By giving lamps in the season of rains one shines with effulgence like Soma himself. The man who gives lamps is never subject to the quality of Darkness.

sa: कृत्वा तत् कर्म लोकानामृषभः सर्वलोकजित्। अवधीस्त्वं रणे सर्वान् समेतान् दैत्यदानवान्॥
en: O foremost of all the worlds, having performed that feat, you have become victorious over all. You have killed all the Daityas and the Danavas mustered in battle.

sa: कृतकृत्यानि चास्त्राणि गतान्यद्य यथागतम्॥ पुनरेष्यन्ति ते हस्ते यदा कालो भविष्यति।
en: Your weapons, having achieved success, have gone away to the place they came from. They will, again, come into your hands when the Time for their coming approaches.

sa: यदा राष्ट्रे धर्ममयं चरन्ति संस्कारं वा राजगुणं ब्रुवाणा:। तैरेवाधर्मश्चरितो धर्ममोहात् तूर्णं जह्यात् सुकृतं दुष्कृतं च॥
en: When the denizens of a kingdom perform pious acts and all religious rites, and praise the good qualities, of the king, the latter acquires riches. When, however, the residents, out of ignorance forsake righteousness and act unrighteously, the king suffers from misery.

sa: अभिवाद्य गुरुं ज्येष्ठं प्रययौ येन फाल्गुनः। परिष्वक्तश्च कौन्तेयो धर्मराजेन भारत॥
en: And saluting his superiors and elder brother, Bhima proceeded in the track of Phalguna. That son of Kunti was then, O Bharata, embraced by the virtuous king Yudhishthira.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच प्रातरुत्थाय कृष्णस्तु कृतवान् सर्वमाह्निकम्। ब्राह्मणैरभ्यनुज्ञात: प्रययौ नगरं प्रति॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having got up (from the bed) in the morning, Krishna attended to the daily rites; and with the permission of the Brahmanas went towards the city.

sa: दुर्गमां पदवीं गत्वा विरराज जनक्षये॥ युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि भस्म कृत्वेव पावकः।
en: Having walked in the path of wicked warriors, Ashvatthaman, after that destruction, looked like the blazing fire at the end of the cycle, reducing all creatures to ashes.

sa: साहसाद् यदि वा मोहात् तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम्॥ वनवासे ह्यनिर्वृत्ते दर्शयेन धनंजयः।
en: Either through bravery or through foolishness. Let such a procedure be adopted. Arjuna shall not bring himself into our view before the expiration of the period of exile.

sa: पाण्डवाश्चेदिपञ्चाला यादवाश्च समागताः। भारतैः सह योत्स्यन्ति किं नु दुःखमतः परम्॥
en: The sons of Pandu, the Chedis, the Panchalas and the Yadavas, united together will fight with the Bharatas; what can be a greater cause of sorrow than this?

sa: यदासीच्चाक्षुषं जन्म द्वितीयं ब्रह्मणो नृप। तदा पितामहेनैव सोमाद् धर्मः परिश्रुतः॥
en: After the second birth of Brahman, viz., when he originated from the eyes of Narayana, O king, the Grandfather (that is, Brahman) then received this religion from Soma.

sa: सर्वकामैर्वृताः केचिद्धेमाभरणभूषिताः। प्राणधारणमात्रं तु केषांचिदुपपद्यते। श्रमेण महता केचित् कुर्वन्ति प्राणधारणम्॥
en: There some, bedecked with ornaments of gold, surround themselves every article of enjoyment. There are again, some that eat very sparingly for only keeping body and soul together.

sa: कर्मणः फलमाप्नोति सुखदुःखे भवाभवौ। विद्यया तदवाप्नोति यत्र गत्वा न शोचति॥ यत्र गत्वा न म्रियते यत्र गत्वा न जायते। न पुनर्जायते यत्र यत्र गत्वा न वर्तते॥ यत्र तद् ब्रह्म परममव्यक्तमचलं ध्रुवम्। अव्याकृतमनायासमव्यक्तं चावियोगि च॥ द्वन्द्वैर्न यत्र बाध्यन्ते मानसेन च कर्मणा। समाः सर्वत्र मैत्राश्च सर्वभूतहिते रताः॥
en: The fruit of acts consist of pleasure and pain, of existence and non-existence. By knowledge one attains to that where there is no occasion for grief; where one becomes freed from both birth and death; where one not subject to decrepitude; where one gets over the state of conscious existence; where is Brahma which is Supreme, Unmanifest, immutable, ever-existent, imperceptible, above the reach of pain, immortal, and transcending destruction; where all become freed from the influence of all pairs of opposites as also of wish or purpose. Raching that stage, they regard everything equally, become universal friends and devoted to the well being of all creatures. There is a huge gulf, O son, between one given to knowledge and one given to acts.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यदि ते ब्राह्मणा लोके वतिनो भुञ्जते हविः। दत्तं ब्राह्मणकामाय कथं तत् सुकृतं भवेत्॥१६
en: Yudhishinira said If Brahmanas observing the vow of celibacy in this world eat, begging the same the offerings one makes during funeral rites, I ask can the shraddha be considered wellperformed if the performer actually makes over those offerings to such Brahmanas.

sa: ततो जग्राह स श्वाङ्गं जीवितार्थी महामुनिः। सदारस्तामुपाहृत्य वने भोक्तुमियेष सः॥
en: Having secured the piece of dog's meat for saving his life, the great ascetic took it away into the forest and wished with his wife to eat it.

sa: दत्त्वा पितामहाया यां मतिं लोकविसर्गिकीम्। तत्रैवान्तर्दधे देवो यत एवागतो हरिः॥
en: After this, Hari, giving to the Grandfather intelligence of the foremost order regarding the Creation, disappeared there and then for going to the place he had come from.

sa: शयानं यान्तमासीनं प्रवृत्तं विषयेषु च। शुभाशुभानि कर्माणि प्रपद्यन्ते नरं सदा॥
en: Whether lying or proceeding, whether sitting idly or engaged in his business, in whatever state a man may be, his pristine deeds good or bad, always approach him.

sa: अहन्यमानेषु पुनः सर्वमेव पराभवेत्। पूर्वे पूर्वतरे चैव सुशास्या ह्यभवन् जनाः॥
en: If they who transgressed those limits were not punished with death, those barriers would soon be destroyed. Men of more ancient times were capable of being governed easily.

sa: शतं सहस्राणि ततश्चरित्वा प्राप्नोति वर्णं हरितं तु पश्चात्। स चैव तस्मिन् निवसत्यनीशो युगक्षये तपसा संवृतात्मा॥
