en: Having passed many hundred thousands of years in that stage, Individual Soul then attains to the colour called Tawny. In that condition he lives in perfect helplessness. At last when his sins are spent his mind, shaking off all attachments, cherishes Renunciation.

sa: ते तपः समुपातिष्ठन् ब्रह्मोक्तं वेदकल्पितम्। स महानियमो नाम तपश्चर्यासु दारुणः॥
en: Arrived there, they began to practise those austere penances that are said by Brahman in the Vedas. Those austerest of penances are known by the name of Mahaniyama.

sa: सुशीघ्रमपि धावन्तं विधानमनुधावति। शेते सह शयानेन येन येन यथा कृतम्॥
en: The pre-ordained act follows the doer even if the latter tries his best for leaving it behind. It sleeps when he sleeps and does whatever else he does.

sa: अजोऽश्वः क्षत्रमित्येतत् सदृशं ब्रह्मणा कृतम्। तस्मादभीक्ष्णं भूतानां यात्रा काचित् प्रसिद्ध्यति॥
en: Goat, horse, and Kshatriya, were created by Brahman for the same purpose (of being useful to everybody). A Kshatriya, therefore, should always seek the happiness of all creatures.

sa: अब्रवीत् तास्तदा वाक्यं शुकः परमधर्मवित्। पिता यद्यनुगच्छेन्मां क्रोशमानः शुकेति वै॥ ततः प्रतिवचो देयं सवेरेव समाहितः। एतन्मे स्नेहतः सर्वे वचनं कर्तुमर्हथ॥
en: Shuka, addressing all of them, that foremost of all pious men, said these words-If my father follow me and repeatedly call after me by my name, do all of you in a body return him an answer for me. Moved by the affection all of you have for me, do you satisfy this request of mine!

sa: ज्येष्ठसाम्ना च देवेशं जगौ नारायणस्तदा॥ गृणन् ब्रह्म परं शक्रः शतरुद्रियमुत्तमम्।
en: Ultering the Jyeshtha Saman Narayana also sang the praises of Bhava, Shakra also did the same with the help of those foremost of Vedic Mantras, viz., the Shata-Rudriyam.

sa: भीष्म उवाच महाकल्पसहस्राणि महाकल्पशतानि च॥ समतीतानि राजेन्द्र सर्गाश्च प्रलयाश्च ह।
en: Bhishma continued "Hundreds and thousands of great cycles, hundreds and thousands of Creations and Dissolutions, O king of kings, have been over and become events of the past.

sa: वानप्रस्थगृहस्थाभ्यां न संसृज्येत कर्हिचित्। अज्ञातलिप्सं लिप्सेत न चैनं हर्ष आविशेत्॥
en: He should never mingle with house-holders and hermits. He should eat such food as he may get without effort. He should never allow joy to possess his heart.

sa: गच्छस्व सुकृतं कृत्सा किं चान्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छसि। यावद् ब्रवीमि विप्रर्षे अष्टावक्र यथातथम्॥
en: Return to your quarters, having achieved such merit. What else is there which yo!' wish to hear (from me)? I shall truly describe it to you, O Ashtavakra.

sa: स्वभावयुक्त्या युक्तस्तु स नित्यं सृजते गुणान्। उर्णनाभिर्यथा सूत्रं विज्ञेयास्तन्तुवद् गुणाः।४९।।
en: One living in this way creates the qualities (i.e. transcends them), like a spider creating threads. The qualities should indeed, be considered as the threads of the spider.

sa: अमृतं ब्राह्मणोच्छिष्टं जनन्या हृदयं कृतम्। तज्जनाः पर्युपासन्ते सत्यं सन्तः समासते॥
en: The remnants of a Brahmana's food are like nectar. They are like the mother's milk. People highly value those remnants. The god, by cating them, attain to Brahma.

sa: इत्युक्तः प्रतिजग्राह तद् वचो हव्यकव्यभुक्। पितामहस्य भगवांस्तथा च तदभूत् प्रभो॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by the Grandfather, the eater of oblations and sacrificial offerings accepted his order. A fourth of that sin then entered his body, O king.

sa: मासमेकं फलाहारो द्वितीयं सलिलाशनः॥ तृतीयं च चतुर्थं च पञ्चमं चानिलाशनः।
en: For one month, I lived on fruits. The second month I lived upon water. The third, the fourth, and the fifth months I passed, living upon air only.

sa: शिशुपालं वधिष्यामि यज्ञे धर्मसुतस्य वै। समागतेषु बलिषु पृथिव्यां सर्वराजसु॥ वासविः सुसहायो वै मम त्वेको भविष्यति।
en: I shall next kill Shisupala in the sacrifice of king Yudhishthira the son of Dharma, into which sacrifice all the kings of the world will bring tribute. In some of these works, only Arjuna, the son of Vasava, will become my assistant.

sa: नित्यमेव सुखं स्वर्गे सुखं दुःखमिहोभयम्। नरके दुःखमेवाहुः सुखं तत्परमं पदम्॥
en: In heaven there is perpetual happiness. Both happiness and misery exist in this world. In hell there is only misery. Happiness is, therefore, the greatest object of acquisition.

sa: शूरा वीराच शतशः सन्ति लोके युधिष्ठिर। येषां संख्यायमानानां दानशूरो विशिष्यते॥
en: In this world, O Yudhishthira, there are hundreds of brave men and heroes. While counting them, he who is a hero in gifts should be considered as superior.

sa: न चाल्पतेजसमृर्षि वेद्म नारदमव्ययम्॥ श्वेतद्वीपं समासाद्य येन दृष्टः स्वयं हरिः।
en: Indeed, I think that Narada, who is above all destruction, was gifted with great energy, for going to White-Island he had succeeded in seeing the person of Hari.

sa: शासितारं च पापानां पितृणां समवर्तिनम्। असृजत् सर्वभूतात्मा निधिपं च धनेश्वरम्॥
en: And he made Yama the ruler of the departed manes of all sinful men. The Supreme Soul of ail creatures also made Kuvera the lord of all riches.

sa: स एवं चतुरो वर्णान् समुत्पाद्य महातपाः। अध्यक्षं सर्वभूतानां धातारमकरोत् स्वयम्॥
en: Endued with great ascetic merit, the destroyer of Madhu, having thus created the four orders of men, made (Dhatri Brahman) the master and ruler of all created beings.

sa: इतो दत्तेन जीवन्ति देवताः पितरस्तथा। तस्माद् दानानि देयानि ब्राह्मणेभ्यो विजानता॥
en: The gods and the departed manes are supported by the gifts one makes to a Brahmana. Hence one endued with knowledge should ever make gifts to the Brahmanas.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच पितामह महाप्राज्ञ सर्वशास्त्रविशारद। श्रुतं मे महदाख्यानमिदं मतिमतां वर॥
en: Yudhishthira said O grandfather, O wisest of men, O you who are learned in all the scriptures, I have heard, this great story, O foremost of intelligent men!

sa: अस्मिंस्तु वै विनिर्वृत्ते दुर्लभे परमप्रिये। इह कामानवाप्नोति प्रत्यक्षं नात्र संशयः॥
en: If Wealth, which is difficult of acquisition and highly agreeable, be acquired, the person who has acquired it, forsooth, is seen to earn all the objects of Desire.

sa: अयं क्रियावतां पन्था व्यक्तीभूतः सनातनः। अनिरुद्ध इति प्रोक्तो लोकसर्गकरः प्रभुः॥
en: This is the eternal path of creatures engaged in acts and observances. The powerful Lord who is charged with the creation of all the worlds is called Aniruddha.

sa: महाभूतानि सृष्ट्वैव तान् गुणान् निर्ममे पुनः। भूतेभ्यश्चैव निष्पन्ना मूर्तिमन्तश्च ताशृणु॥
en: Having created the Great Creatures he then created their qualities. Combining the Great Creatures, he then created various embodied Beings. Hear me as I describe them to you.

sa: न यमो नान्तकः क्रुद्धो न मृत्युीमविक्रमः। ईशते नृपते सर्वे योगस्यामिततेजसः॥
en: Neither Yama, nor the Destroyer, nor Death, himself of terrible power, when irate, ever succeeds in lording over the Yogin, O king, who is gifted with immeasurable energy.

sa: नित्यं क्रोधात् तपो रक्षेच्छ्रियं रक्षेच्च मत्सरात्। विद्यां मानावमानाभ्यामात्मानं तु प्रमादतः॥
en: One should always protect his penances from anger, and his prosperity from pride. One should always protect his knowledge from honour and dishonour, and his soul from error.

sa: नवनीतं यथा दध्नस्तथा कामोऽर्थधर्मतः। श्रेयस्तैलं हि पिण्याकाद् घृतं श्रेय उदश्वितः।
en: As butter is the essence of curds, so is Desire the essence of Profit and Virtue. Oil is better than oil-seeds. Clarified butter is better than sour milk.

sa: आपन्ने तूत्तरां काष्ठां सूर्ये यो निधनं व्रजेत्। नक्षत्रे च मुहूर्ते च पुण्ये राजन् स पुण्यकृत्॥ अयोजयित्वा क्लेशेन जनं प्लाव्य च दुष्कृतम्। मृत्युनाऽऽत्मकृते नेह कर्म कृत्वाऽऽत्पशक्तिभिः॥
en: That man is considered as righteous who meets with dissolution when the Sun is in the northern declension, and at a time and under a constellation both of which are sacred and auspicious, He is righteous who, having purified himself of all sins and performed all his acts according to the best of his might and having abstained from giving pain to any man, meets with death when it comes.

sa: यद्यजीवं शरीरं तु पञ्चभूतसमन्वितम्। शरीरे मानसे दुःखे कस्तां वेदयते रुजम्॥
en: If this body, composed of the give elements, has no life, who or what then is that which feels misery on account of either physical or metal pain?

sa: नाहमेतादृशं बुद्धं हन्तुमिच्छामि बन्धने॥ आनृशंस्यं परो धर्मो ह्यनुक्रोशश्च मे त्वयि।
en: I do not wish to afflict an enlightened person like you by keeping him in chains. Abstention from injury is the greatest religion. I feel mercy for you.

sa: सत्यं वेदास्तथाङ्गानि सत्यं विद्यास्तथा विधिः। व्रतचर्या तथा सत्यमोङ्कारः सत्यमेव च॥
en: Truth is the Vedas and their branches. Truth is knowledge. Truth is the Ordinance. Truth is the observance of vows and fasts. Truth is the Prime Syllable OM.

sa: तेषां च वैरमुत्पन्नं कालयोगेन वै द्विजा एतच्छोचाम्यहं ब्रह्मन् दैवेन समभिप्लुता॥
en: Indra addressed him in these harsh words In former days, O lady, you gave me great pain, for you did perform a sacrifice that is disliked by Indra.

sa: चतुर्णामेव वर्णानामागमः पुरुषर्षभ। अतोऽन्ये त्वतिरिक्ता ये ते वै संकरजाः स्मृताः॥
en: Only these four orders of men, O king, were thus created. They who belong to classes besides these are said to have originated from an intermixture of these.

sa: ये हि निष्कलुषा लोके पुण्यपापविवर्जिताः। तेषां वै क्षेममध्वानं गच्छतां द्विजसत्तम॥
en: The path that is theirs, O foremost of twiceborn ones, that are stainless and that are freed from both virtue and sin, is fraught with auspiciousness and happiness.

sa: एतदेवं विकुर्वाणो बुध्यमानो न बुध्यते। गुणान् धारयते ह्येष सृजत्याक्षिपते तदा॥
en: On account of such transformations Individual Soul fails to understand the Supreme Soul, for he has the three qualities and creates and withdraws into himself what he creates.

sa: इति सा शकुनी वाक्यं पञ्जरस्था तपस्विनी। अतिदुःखान्विता प्रोक्त्वा भर्तारं समुदैक्षत॥
en: The amiable she-pigeon, laden with sorrow, and casting her eyes upon her husband from the fowler's cage within which she had been put, said these words to him.

sa: कुटुम्बार्थं च दास्याश्च साहाय्यं चाप्यथाकरोत्। तत्रावसत् स वर्षांश्च समृद्धे शबरालये॥
en: He began to help the relatives and kinsmen of the female slave the robber-chief gave him. Thus he lived for many years in that prosperous village of hunters.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच पितामह महाप्राज्ञ कुरूणां प्रीतिवर्धन। प्रश्नं कञ्चितप्रवक्ष्यामि तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: O grandfather, you of great wisdom, I shall ask you a question. You should, O enhancer of the joy of the Kurus, to describe it fully to me.

sa: संयोज्य मनसाऽऽत्मानमीणूंमुत्सृज्य मोहनीम्। त्यक्त्वा कामं च मोहं च तदा ब्रह्मत्वमश्नुते॥
en: By controlling the mind and the soul, by renouncing malice that stupefies the mind, and by throwing off desire and stupefaction, one is said to attain to Brahma.

sa: अहं त्वनेन नागेन्द्र सत्यपूर्वं समाहिता। प्रस्थाप्यो मत्सकाशं स सम्प्राप्तो भुजगोत्तमः॥
en: O king of the Nagas, I have made a promise to him that I would send you to him as soon as you would return to your house.

sa: एवमेषा महाराज जापकस्य गतिर्यथा। एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि॥
en: Thus, O king, I have described to you about the end acquired by Reciters. I have told you everything. What else do you wish to hear from me?

sa: तस्य पक्षाग्रविक्षेपैः क्लमं व्यपनयत् खगः। पूजां चाप्यकरोद् धीमान् भोजनं चाप्यकल्पयत्।॥
en: By flapping his wings he began to fan his guest and remove his fatigue. Highly intelligent as he was, he adored Gautama and made arrangements for his food.

sa: मार्जारचाषमण्डूकान् काकं व्यालं च मूषिकम्॥ उक्तः पशुसमो दोषो राजन् प्राणिनिपातनात्।
en: For killing a cat, a chasa, a frog, a crow, a reptile or a rat, it has been said, one incurs the sin of animal slaughter O king.

sa: बद्धश्च वारुणैः पाशैर्वज्रेण च समाहतः। हतदारो हृतधनो ब्रूहि कस्मान्न शोचसि॥
en: You are fettered with Varuna's noose and has been struck with my thunderbolt. Your wives and riches have been taken away. Tell us why you do not grieve.

sa: स हि तस्मिन् समुत्पन्ने ब्रह्मवध्याकृते भय॥ नलिन्या बिसमध्यस्थ उवासाब्दगणान् बहून्।
en: When the sin of Brahmanicide thus stuck to his body and filled him with terror, Indra entered the fibres of a lotus-stalk and lived there for many years.

sa: प्राणानां संनिपाताच्च संनिपातः प्रजायते। उष्मा चाग्निरिति ज्ञेयो योऽनं पचति देहिनाम्॥
en: The various vital air passing through these canals mix with each other. The heat which lives in Prana is called Ushman. This heat causes digestion in embodied creatures.

sa: एते प्रमत्तं पुरुषमप्रमत्तास्तुदन्ति च। वृका इव विलुम्पन्ति दृष्ट्वैव पुरुषं बलात्॥
en: They goad and afflict a careless or a foolish man. Indeed, as soon as they see a person, they attack him powerfully like wolves jumping upon their pray.

sa: अव्यक्त क्षेत्रमित्युक्तं तथा सत्त्वं तथेश्वरः। अनीश्वरमतत्त्वं च तत्त्वं तत् पञ्चविंशकम्॥
en: The Unmanifest is called Kshetra, understanding, and also the supreme Lord; while Purusha, which is the twenty-fifth principle has nothing superior to it and is not a principle.

sa: विपर्ययेण मे मन्युस्तेन संतप्यते मनः। जातिं स्मराम्यहं तुभ्यमतस्त्वां प्रहसामि वै॥
en: I am really very sorry at this change of condition. My heart burns at the thought. I remember our former births, hence do I laugh at seeing you.

sa: एवं विवदमानौ स्वस्त्वामिहाभ्यागतौ नृप। कुरु धर्ममधर्म वा विनये नौ समादध॥
en: Disputing with each other about this, we have both come to you, O King, Whether you judge rightly or wrongly, settle our dispute and put us in peace.

sa: प्राड्नदीं च समासाद्य कृतात्मा भवति द्विजः। सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा शक्रलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Going to Prangnadi, a twice-born becomes successful in his wishes and his soul being purified and sins being all destroyed he goes to the region of Shakra (Indra).

sa: देवो वा यदि वा यक्षो रुद्रादन्यो व्यवस्थितः। अहमेनं शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्नयामि यमसादनम्॥
en: Whether he is a celestials or a Yaksha, any body cxcept Rudra (Shiva), I Shall soon send him to the abode of Yama with my these sharp arrows."

sa: प्रस्थिता: स्वानि राष्ट्राणि मामापृच्छ्य परंतपाः। अनुव्रजत भद्रं वो विषयान्तं नृपोत्तमान्॥
en: These chastisers of foes are now desirous of returning to their kingdoms after bidding me farewell. Blessed (brothers), follow these excellent kings to the confines of our kingdom".

sa: न स पार्थस्य संग्रमे कलामर्हति षोडशीम्। यच्चापि ते भयं कर्णान्मनसिस्थमरिंदम॥
en: In battle Karna is not equal even to a sixteenth part of Partha (Arjuna). The fear that you bear in your mind from Karna, O chastiser of foes.

sa: बृहदश्व उवाच सा तच्छ्रुत्वानवद्याङ्गी सार्थवाहवचस्तदा। जगाम सह तेनैव सार्थेन पतिलालसा॥
en: Brihadashva said: Thereupon that beauteous lady, hearing the words of the leader of the caravan, went away with the company of travellers, hoping to find out her lord.

sa: राज्ञामुपायश्चाश्च बुद्धिमत्रपराक्रमाः। निग्रहप्रग्रहौ चैव दाक्ष्यं वै कार्यसाधकम्॥ साम्ना दानेन भेदेन दण्डेनोपक्षणेन च। साधनीयानि कर्माणि समासव्यासयोगतः॥
en: Spies are the most important helps to a king; tact, diplomacy, prowess, chastisement, favour and cleverness lead to success. Success should also be attained through the following, either in their combination or in separation, namely conciliation, gifts, sowing dissension's, chastisement and slight.

sa: ततो गच्छेत् सुवर्णाख्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्॥ तत्र विष्णुः प्रसादार्थं रुद्रमाराधयत् पुरा। वरांश्च सुबहल्लेभे दैवतेषु सुदुर्लभान्॥
en: Then one should go to the Tirtha called Suvarna, celebrated all over the three worlds. There Vishnu in the days of yore worshipped Rudra in order to get his grace. He obtained many boons difficult to be got by even the celestials.

sa: तमांसीव यथा सूर्यो वृक्षानग्निर्घनान् खगः। तथा स्कन्दोऽजयच्छत्रून् स्वेन वीर्येण कीर्तिमान्।१०२॥
en: As the sun destroys darkness or as fire destroys a forest or as the wind drives away clouds. In this manner, the illustrious Skanda defeated all his enemies.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच विवस्वतः सुतो राजन् महर्षिः सुप्रतापवान्। बभूव नरशार्दूल प्रजापतिसमद्युतिः॥
en: Markandeya said : O king, O foremost of men, there was a mighty great Rishi; he was the son of Vivasvata and he was as effulgent as Prajapati.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स गत्वा नलिनी रम्यां राक्षसैरभिरक्षिताम्। कैलासशिखराभ्याशे ददर्श शुभकाननाम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Going there, he (Bhima) saw, near the Kailasha peak, that charming lake adorned with lotuses and surrounded by blessed woods and guarded by the Rakshasas.

sa: भीमसेन उवाच राक्षसास्तं न पश्यामिधनेश्वरमिहान्तिके। दृष्ट्वापि च महाराजं नाहं याचितुमुत्सहे॥
en: Bhimasena said: Rakshasas, I do not see the lord of wealth here. Even if I see that great king, I shall not pray (for the flowers) to him,

sa: भवता संगमो यस्य भ्राता चैवधनंजयः। वासवः स्मरते यस्य को नामाभ्यधिकस्ततः॥
en: Who can be more fortunate than he who has you for his company, who has Dhananjaya (Arjuna) as his brother, nay who is remembered by Vasava (Indra) himself.

sa: कर्मदोषश्च वै विद्वन्नात्मजातिकृतेन ते। कञ्चित् कालमुष्यतां वै ततोऽसि भविता द्विजः॥
en: These being the duties of your profession, the stain of evil Karma will not attach to you. After living here for sometime you shall again become a Brahmana.

sa: यत् तद् भूतहितं कार्यं सुरेन्द्रेण निवेदितम्। सम्प्रतिश्रुत्य तत् सर्वं भगवाँल्लोकपूजितः॥ जगाम बदरीं रम्यां स्वमेवाश्रममण्डलम्। एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु पृथिव्यां पृथिवीपतिः॥ कान्यकुब्जे महानासीत् पार्थिवः सुमहाबलः। गाधीति विश्रुतो लोके वनवासं जगाम ह॥ वने तु तस्य वसतः कन्या जज्ञेऽप्सर:समा। ऋचीको भार्गवस्तां च वरयामास भारत॥
en: All that was beneficial to the world was told by the lord of celestials. The exalted one, the adored of all the world, (Vishnu) promising to do all. Indra adviced the welfare of all creatures. Then hearing everythig, lord of all world went to Badari, his most favourite hermitage. At this very time there lived on earth a mighty king in Kanyakubja, monarch of great prowess, known in the world by the name of Gadhi. But he retired into the forest. .When he was living in the forest, a daughter was born to him as beautiful as an Apsara. O descendant of Bharata, Rechika, the son of Bhrigu asked her for marriage.

sa: तूणौ चाप्यक्षयौ भूयस्तव पार्थ यथोचितौ। भविष्यति शरीरं च नीरुजं कुरनन्दन॥
en: O Partha, these two quivers which is fit only for you, will again be inexhaustible. O descendant of Kuru, your body will be free from pain and disease.

sa: तत्र पिण्डारकं नाम तापसाचरितं शिवम्। उज्जयन्तश्च शिखरी क्षिप्रं सिद्धिकरो महान्॥
en: There is also the Tirtha called Pindarka, frequented by ascetics and capable of producing great merit. In this region is the great mountain Ujjyayanta which produces great success.

sa: त्रिद्वारामर्थसिद्धिं तु नानुपश्यन्ति ये नराः। तथैवानर्थसिद्धिं च यथा लोकास्तथैव ते॥
en: Those persons, who do not observe these three doors for the accomplishment of objects as well as for the failure, are dull and exist like the body itself.

sa: अशक्तश्चैव एवाहं तामाहर्तुं नृपश्रियम्। सहायांश्च न पश्यामि तेन मृत्यु विचिन्तये॥
en: I am alone incapable of acquiring such royal prosperity. I do not also see any one who can help me in doing it. Therefore I think of death.

sa: तैर्लब्धा द्रौपदी भार्या द्रुपदश्च सुतैः सह। सहायः पृथिवीलाभे वासुदेवश्च वीर्यवान्॥
en: They obtained Draupadi as wife and Drupada with his two sons (as allies); and also the greatly powerful Vasudeva (Krishna) as a help to acquire the whole world.

sa: आत्मना भ्रातृभिश्चैवधर्मेण सुकृतेन च। इष्टेन च शपे राजन् सूदयिष्यामि राक्षसम्॥
en: O king, by my own self, by my brothers, by my merit, by my good deeds and by my sacrifices, I swear that I shall kill this Rakshasa."

sa: सर्वे हि स्वं समुत्थानमुपजीवन्ति जन्तवः। अपिधाता विधाता च यथायमुदके बकः॥
en: All creatures live according to the impression of the pristine life, even the creatures and the ordainers of the universe like a crane that lives on the water.

sa: यत्र कुत्सा प्रयोक्तव्या भीष्म बालतरैनरैः। तमिमं ज्ञानवृद्धः सन् गोपं संस्तोतुमिच्छसि॥
en: O Bhishma, how do you, superior as you are in knowledge, desire to praise the cowherd (Krishna) whose evil repute is told even by men with childish intelligence,

sa: एकपादांश्च तत्राहमपश्यं द्वारि वारितान्। राजानो बलिमादाय नानावर्णाननेकशः॥ कृष्णग्रीवान् महाकायान् रासभान् दूरपातिनः। आजहुर्दशसाहस्रान् विनीतान् दिक्षु विश्रुतान्॥
en: And also those that possessed only one leg. I saw, were refused admittance at the gate. These kings brought as tribute ten thousand celebrated asses of various and innumerable colours, with black necks and huge bodies, with great speed and much docility.

sa: त्वामुपस्थास्यतश्चैव नित्यं वार्ष्णेयजीवलौ। एताभ्यां रंस्यसे सार्धं वस वै मयि बाहुक॥
en: Varshneya and Jivala shall always be guided by you; and in whose company shall you pass your days in joy. O Bahuka! do you, therefore, stay with me.

sa: तत्र स्नात्वा नरः क्षिप्रं वासवं लोकमाप्नुयात्। सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा गच्छेत परमां गतिम्॥
en: Bathing in it a man soon obtains the region of Vashava (Indra) and his soul becomes pure with all his sins destroyed; he also obtains the highest state.

sa: न तात चफ्लैर्भाव्यमिह प्राप्तैः कथंचन। उषित्वेह यथाकामं यथाश्रद्धं विहृत्य च। ततः शस्त्रजितां तात पृथिवीं पालयिष्यसि॥
en: O affectionate one, do not betray any restless spirit while remaining here. Dwelling here quite at ease and amusing yourself as you choose, you shall, in the long run, crushing your foes, by the prowess of your weapons, govern the earth. ones

sa: तस्यां गिरिवरः पुण्यो गयो राजर्षिसत्कृतः। शिवं ब्रह्मसरो यत्र सेवितं त्रिदशर्षिभिः॥
en: Here there is also that foremost of hills, the sacred Gaya, adored by the celestials Rishis, where there is the auspicious lake of Brahma, frequented by the celestials.

sa: ततः समुद्रतीरेण जगाम वसुधाधिपः। भ्रातृभिः सहितो वीरः कालिङ्गान् प्रति भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, that ruler of earth, the hero, accompanied by his brothers then went along the shore of the ocean to the land of the Kalinga.

sa: क्रोधं त्यक्त्वा तु पुरुषः सम्यक् तेजोऽभिपद्यते। कालयुक्तं महाप्राज्ञे क्रुद्धस्तेज: सुदुःसहम्॥
en: Renouncing anger a man can display his true energy, whereas it is difficult, O highly wise one, for an angry man to display energy at the proper hour.

sa: हन्त्यवध्यानपि क्रुद्धो गुरून् क्रुद्धस्तुदत्यपि। तस्मात् तेजसि कर्तव्यः क्रोधो दूरे प्रतिष्ठितः॥
en: The angry man kills those who should not be killed; he even slays his preceptor; therefore a man of character should always leave off anger at a distance.

sa: दैवतं च पति मेने भर्तुश्चित्तानुसारिणी। कर्मणा मनसा वाचा नान्यचित्ताभ्यगात् पतिम्॥
en: That lady, always pursuing the thoughts of her husband, regarded the husband, as a celestial; and either in action, thought or speech, she never considered her husband otherwise.

sa: यत् त्वयोक्तं नरश्रेष्ठ तत् समक्षं महाद्युते। स्मर्तुमर्हसि कल्याणा वचनं पार्थिवर्षभ॥
en: O foremost of men! O auspicious one! O your of blazing lustre! O excellent of kings! you ought to remember the words you did utter in my presence.

sa: ततो गत्वा सरस्वत्याः सागरस्य च संगमे॥ गोसहस्रफलं तस्य स्वर्गलोकं च विन्दति। प्रभया दीप्यते नित्यमग्निवद् भरतर्षभ॥
en: One should then go to the place where river Sarasvati mixes with the ocean. He who goes there obtains the fruit giving away one thousand kine and acquires also heaven. O best of the Bharata race, he always blazes like the fire.

sa: महेन्द्रस्य नियोगेन त्वत्तः सम्प्रणयेन च। तस्य चाहं गुणौघेन फाल्गुने जातमन्मथा। गच्छ त्वं हि यथाकाममागमिष्याम्यहं सुखम्॥
en: At the command of Indra and for my friendship for you and also moved by the many virtues of Falguni (Arjuna), I am already full of the god of love. Go therefore wherever you like to go I shall go to him.

sa: त्वत्कृतेऽहं सुरेशेन प्रेषितो वरवर्णिनि। प्रियं कुरु महेन्द्रस्य मम चैवात्मनश्च ह॥
en: O charming lady, I have been sent to you by the chief of the celestials. Do the favourite work of Mahendra and of myself and also of yourself.

sa: यः स जानन महातेजा वृद्धस्यैकं ममात्मजम्। गतवानेव कोपस्य वशं परमदुर्मतिः॥
en: That greatly effulgent one knows me to be old and (he knew also) that I had only one son. But that wicked-minded one still became subject to anger.

sa: तमूर्ध्वबाहुं दृष्टैव सूर्यस्याभिमुखे स्थितम्। तेजोराशिं दीप्यमानं हुताशनमिवैधितम्॥ राक्षसाधिपतिः श्रीमान् मणिमानाम मे सखा। मौदज्ञानभावाच्च दर्पान्मोहाच्च पार्थिव॥
en: Beholding that mass of lustre, blazing and bright as fire, with upraised arms facing the sun, my illustrious friend Maniman, the lord of the Rakshasas, who was ranging through the firmament, O lord of the earth, through stupidity, foolishness arrogance and ignorance.

sa: या त्वाहं चन्दनादिग्धमपश्यं सूर्यवर्चसम्। सा त्वां पङ्कमलादिग्धं दृष्ट्वा मुह्यामि भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, I am beside myself on seeing you pasted with mud, you, gifted with the effulgence of sun whom I saw before pasted with sandal.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्ता तु पार्थेन उर्वशी क्रोधमूर्च्छिता। वेपन्ती भृकुटीवक्रा शशापाथधनंजयम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed by Partha, Urvashi lost her senses out of anger. Trembling in anger and contracting her brows, she thus cursed Dhananjaya (Arjuna).

sa: तस्मिन् प्रयाते दुर्धर्षे दिवि शब्दो महानभूत्। एष श्रीमानवध्योऽद्य धुन्धुमारो भविष्यति॥
en: When the haughty one was gone away, a loud noise was heard in the heaven, uttering the words-'this invincible hero will this day be the slayer of Dhundhu.'

sa: ततो गृध्रवटं गच्छेत् स्थानं देवस्यधीमतः। स्नायीत भस्मना तत्र अभिगम्य वृषध्वजम्॥
en: Then one should go to Gridhravata which is the region of the god, the wielder of trident. Going to Vrishadhvaja (Shiva), one should rub his body with ashes.

sa: सभ्या ऊचुः अहो धिग बान्धवा नैनं बोधयन्ति महद् भयम्। बुद्ध्या बुध्येन्न वा बुध्येदयं वै भरतर्षभः॥
en: "Alas! Fie on the friends of Dhritarashtra that they do not tell him of his great danger! O best of the Bharata race (Dhritarashtra), whether he understand or not out of his own sense, it is your duty to tell him plainly.

sa: ततः पर्वतभारार्त्तान् मन्दप्राणविचेष्टितान्। हयान् संदृश्य मां सूतः प्राह तात्कालिकं वचः॥
en: Seeing my horses, afflicted with the weight of the rocks and almost at the point of death, my charioteer spoke to me in words suitable to the occasion.

sa: राजा तु नैषधो नाम वीरसेनसुतो नलः। भार्येयं तस्य कल्याणी पुण्यश्लोकस्यधीमतः॥
en: Also there is the king of the Nishadhas, named Nala, who is the son of Virasena. This blessed damsel is the daughter of that virtuous and intelligent monarch.

sa: तमास्थित: संददृशे किरीटी स्रग्वीनवान्याभरणानि बिभ्रत्। धनंजयो वज्रधरप्रभावः श्रिया ज्वलन् पर्वतमाजगाम॥
en: Placed in that car, appeared Kirita wearing garlands and fresh ornaments (Then) Dhananjaya, powerful as the wielder of the thunderbolt and blazing of beauty, alighted on (that) mountain,

sa: प्रवृत्तं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य चक्रं राज्ञो महात्मनः। पराजिताः पाण्डवेया विपत्तिं परमां गताः॥
en: Dushasana Said The absolute sovereignty of son of Dhritarashtra, the high-souled king, (Duryodhana) has (now) commenced. The Pandavas are vanquished, and they have been plunged into great misery.

sa: कृष्णशुल्कावुभौ पक्षौ गयायां यो वसेन्नरः। पुनात्यासप्तमं राजन् कुलं नास्त्यत्र संशयः॥
en: O king, the man who lives at Gaya during both the white and the black fortnight, no doubt sanctifies the seven generations of his race upwards and downwards.

sa: तं पतन्तं महाबाहो शूलपट्टिशपाणयः। अभिघ्नन्तो भृशं वीर मम चेतो ह्यकम्पयन्॥
en: O mighty-armed hero, when he was thus falling, the hostile warriors with lances and axes in their hands began to strike him grievously. At this my heart trembled.

sa: जातमात्रां च तां दृष्ट्वा वैदर्भः पृथिवीपतिः। प्रहर्षेण द्विजातिभ्यो न्यवेदयत भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, as soon as she was born, seeing her, that ruler of earth, the king of Vidharbha communicated it to the Brahmanas in great joy.

sa: पुरैवागमनादस्माद् वेदाहं त्वांधनंजय। अतः परं त्वहं वै त्वां दर्शये भरतर्षभ॥
en: O Dhananjaya, even before my arrival here I had known you (would come). After this, O best of the Bharatas, I will reveal myself to you (in heaven).

sa: न तस्योरसि नो मूर्भि न काये न भुजद्वये। अन्तरं पाण्डवश्रेष्ठ पश्याम्यनिचितं शरैः॥ स तु बाणवरोत्पीडाद् विस्रवत्यसृगुल्वणम्। अभिवृष्टे यथा मेधे गिरिगैरिकधातुमान्॥
en: O best of the Pandavas, there was not a spot on his breast or on his head or in his body or in his two arms which was not covered with arrows. Blood flowed profusely from his wounds thus inflicted by the arrows. He looked like a hill of red chalk after a shower of rain.

sa: अपापचेतसं पापो य एवं कृतवान् नलम्। तस्माद् दुःखतरं प्राप्य जीवत्वसुखजीविकाम्॥
en: May that sinful wretch, who has reduced Nala of pious heart into this plight, live a more miserable life than his (Nala's) own, fraught with such greater woes.'

sa: वैन्यं विधातेत्याहात्रिरत्र नौ संशयो महान्। श्रुत्वैव तु महात्मानो मुनयोऽभ्यद्रवन् दुतम्॥
en: Atri says that Vainya rules over our destiny. But we entertain a grave doubt on the point. Markandeya said : Hearing this, those high-souled sages soon repaired to

sa: त्वमप्यनेन कौन्तेय निवातकवचान् रणे। विजेता युधि विक्रम्य पुरेव मघवा वशी॥
en: You too, O son of Kunti, mounted on this (car) shall, displaying your prowess, obtain victory over the Nivatakavachas in fight as of yore the self-contained Maghavana did.

sa: तया प्रदेशितो राजा ब्राह्मणान् वशवर्तिनः। प्रास्थापयद् दिशः सर्वा यतध्वं नलमार्गणे॥
en: Thus urged by the queen, the king sent out the dependant Brahmanas in all directions; and enjoined them to strive to find out the whereabouts of king Nala.

sa: अथ तं सेदुकं ब्राह्मणः कश्चिद् वेदाध्ययनसम्पन्न आशिषं दत्त्वा गुर्वर्थी भिक्षितवान्॥
en: Once upon a time, a Brahmana having completed his study of the Vedas, came to Seduka; and uttering a benediction upon him he begged (wealth for his preceptor);

sa: वासुदेव उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु कौन्तेय सूतपुत्रस्ततोऽब्रवीत्। प्रद्युम्नं बलिनां श्रेष्ठं मधुरं श्लक्ष्णमञ्जसा॥
en: Krishna said: O son of Kunti, having been thus addressed, the son of Suta (the charioteer) then replied to Pradyumna, that foremost of heroes, in these sweet words.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच गवाश्वं बहुधेनूकमसंख्येयमजाविकम्। यत् किंचिदनुपर्णाशां प्राक् सिन्धोरपि सौबल। एतन्मम धनं सर्वं तेन दीव्याम्यहं त्वया॥
en: Yudhisthira said O son of Subala, I have innumerable kine, horses, milch cows with claves, goats and shee; in the country extending from the Parnasha to the eastern bank of the Sindhu (river). With this wealth I shall (now) play with you.

sa: मणिनागं ततो गत्वा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: There going to Maninaga one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: लोमश उवाच तत आयव्ययौ पूर्णौ तेषां राजा न्यवेदयत्। एतज्ज्ञात्वा ह्यपादध्वं यदत्र व्यतिरिच्यते॥ तत् आयव्ययौ दृष्ट्वा समौ सममतिर्द्विजः। सर्वथा प्राणिनां पीडामुपादानादमन्यत॥
en: Lomasha said: Telling them that his income and expenditure were the same that king said, “knowing this take from my wealth whatever you please to take. Having seen that his income and expenditure were the same, the Rishi who saw both sides with equal eyes thought that if he took anything, he would injure other creatures.

sa: सोऽहममिच्छामि तत् सर्वं विधिवद् देवकीसुत। उपयोक्तुं द्विजायेभ्यो हव्यवाहे च माधव॥
en: O Madhava, O son of Devaki, I desire to devote all this wealth to the Brahmanas and to the. carrier of sacrificial libations (Agni) according to the ordinance.

sa: अन्तर्भूमौ च येऽगृहणन् दानवा रथवाजिनः। अनुप्रविश्य तान् बाणाः प्राहिण्वन् यमसादनम्॥
en: And the shafts, penetrating those Danavas, who entering into the bowels of the earth had seized the horses and the car, sent them to the abode of Yama.

sa: धय॑र्धनागमैतस्य ववृधे निचयो पहान्। कर्तुं यस्य न शक्येत क्षयो वर्षशतैरपि॥
en: The large treasury of the King became so much filled with the hoards of wealth virtuously obtained that it could not be emptied even in one hundred years.

sa: वामदेव उवाच त्वया त्रातं राजकुलं शुभेक्षणे वरं वृणीष्वाप्रतिमं ददानि ते। प्रशाधीमं स्वजनं राजपुत्रि इक्ष्वाकुराज्यं सुमहच्चाप्यनिन्द्ये॥
en: Vamadeva said : O princess, O beautiful-eyed lady, you have saved this royal dynasty. Ask of me a matchless boon. I will grant you whatever you ask. O faultless lady; rule over your these kinsmen and over the kingdom of the Ikshvakus.

sa: ते युद्धे सन्यवर्तन्त समुद्रस्य नेमे शक्या मानुषेण युद्धेनेति प्रचिन्त्य तत्॥
en: They were, then, engaged in the fight, like billows on the sea. Thereupon, considering that they would not be destroyed by the manner of fighting peculiar to mortals,

sa: ततो निवृत्तहृदयः पुनरागम्य तां सभाम्। दमयन्तीं तदा दृष्ट्वा सरोद निषधाधिपः॥
en: But then his heart being attracted towards Damayanti, the ruler of the Nishadhas, came back to that inn; and finding her in that condition he began to lament:

sa: अरक्ष्यमाणान्येतानि त्रैलोक्यस्यापि पाण्डव। भवन्ति स्म विनाशाय मैवं भूयः कृथाः क्वचित्।।२२।
en: (But), O Pandava, if they are not (carefully) preserved, they will lead to the destruction of the three worlds. Therefore, do not attempt such a (rash) act again.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच विलक्षयंस्तु राजेन्द्रो दुर्योधनपिता तदा। किर्मीरः कथं भीमेन पातितः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The king of kings, the father of Duryodhana (Dhritarashtra), thus averting the curse, asked Maitreya (to tell him) how Kirmira had been kiiled by Bhima.

sa: राजोवाच किंस्वित् सुप्तं न निमिषति किंस्विज्जातं न चोपति। कस्य स्विद्धृदयं नास्ति किं स्विद् वेगेन वर्धते॥
en: The King said: What is it that does not close its eyes even when it is asleep? What is it that does not move when born? What is it that has no heart and what is it that increases in its speed?

sa: श्वेतः कृतयुगे वर्णः पीतस्त्रेतायुगे मम। रक्तो द्वापमासाद्य कृष्णः कलियुगे तथा॥
en: In the Satya Yuga I become white, in the Treta Yuga I become yellow, in the Dvapara I become red and in the Kali Yuga I become black.

sa: तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वाणो वाजपेयमवाप्नुयात्। देवकूटं समासाद्य ब्रह्मर्षिगणसेवितम्॥ अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्।
en: Bathing there one obtains the fruits of Vajapeya sacrifice. Going to Devakuta, frequented by the celestials Rishis, one obtains the fruit of Ashvamedha (sacrifice) and saves his race.

sa: हन्तास्मि तरसा युद्धे त्वामेवेह सबान्धवम्। यदि स्थास्यसि संग्रामे क्षत्रधर्मेण सौबल॥
en: O son of Subala, I shall certainly kill you with all your friends and relatives if you stay in the fight according to the usage of the Kshatriyas.

sa: तस्मिन् गृहीते राजेन्द्र स्थितं दुःशासनं रथे। पर्यगृह्णन्त गन्धर्वाः परिवार्य समन्ततः॥
en: O king of kings, when he was thus taken prisoner, the Gandharvas surrounded the car on which Duhshasana was seated; and they took him also as a prisoner.

sa: अद्य रात्रौ दिवा चाहं त्वत्कृते भरतर्षभ। प्रजागरे प्रपश्यामि विचित्रं देहमात्मनः॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, I was sleepless through the day and through the night. I was suing myself as one that has been lost on earth.

sa: कथं ह्यविजितां कृष्णां मन्यसे धृतराष्ट्रज। यदा सभायां सर्वस्वं न्यस्तवान् पाण्डवाग्रजः॥
en: o son of Dhritarashtra, how do you consider that Krishna (Draupadi) is not won, when the eldest of the Pandavas have staked all his possessions in this assembly?

sa: किंतु नाद्यानुशोचामि तथाऽऽत्मानं विनाशितम्। यथा तु विपिने न्यस्तान् भ्रातृन् राज्यपरिच्युतान्।।२९।
en: But this day I do not so much grieve for my death as for my brothers, who have been driven from their kingdom into exile in the forest.

sa: अहं विष्णोरहं ब्रह्मा शक्रश्चाहं सुराधिपः। अहं वैश्रवणो राज यमः प्रेताधिपस्तथा॥
en: I am Vishnu, I am Brahma, I am Indra, the lord of the celestials. I am king Vaisravana (Kubera), I am Yama, the king of the deceased spirits.

sa: पावकस्याज्ञया चैनमर्चयामास पार्थिवः॥ सत्कारेण नरव्याघ्रं सहदेवं युधाम्पतिम्। प्रतिगृह्य च तां पूजां करे च विनिवेश्य च॥
en: On the disappearance of Pavaka king Nila came there, and at the command of that deity (Agni), the king worshipped with due rites that best of men and that master in war, Sahadeva, He accepted his worship and made him pay tribute.

sa: पूजयामाय माद्रेयः पावकं भरतर्षभ॥ पावके विनिवृत्ते तु नीलो राजाभ्यगात् तदा।
en: O best of the Bharata race, the son of Madri rose up with a cheerful heart and bowing down his head with joined hands, he worshipped Pavaka (Agni).

sa: आभ्यामर्थाय सोमं त्वं ग्रहीष्यसि यदि स्वयम्। वज्रं ते प्रहरिष्यामि घोररूपमनुत्तमम्॥
en: "If you take up the Soma to offer it to those two celestials, I shall hurl at you my fearful thunder which is superior to all existing weapons."

sa: किंचित् तु नापराधं ते कृतवानस्मि नैषध। अज्ञातवासे वसतो मद्गृहे वसुधाधिप॥
en: O prince of the Nishadh..s, O lord of the earth, perhaps I had not donc any wrong to you, while you were living in my house in disguise.

sa: करभारभयाद् भीता गृहस्थाः परिमोषकाः। मुनिच्छद्माकृतिच्छन्ना वाणिज्यमुपजीविनः॥ मिथ्या च नखरोमाणिधारयन्ति तदा द्विजाः। अर्थलोभान्नरव्याघ्र तथा च ब्रह्मचारिणः॥
en: Men, leading domestic life, being afraid of the weight of taxation, become deceivers; while Brahmanas assuming the disguise of ascetics earn wealth by trade. O foremost of men, many Brahmanas become from their avarice of wealth religious mendicants of the Brahmacharya order.

sa: दमयन्त्युवाच यथासौ रथनिर्घोषः पूरयन्निव मेदिनीम्। ममाह्लादयते चेतो नल एष महीपतिः॥
en: Damayanti said : As the rattle of this car fills the entire earth and highly delights my heart, it must be king Nala, who comes from that direction.

sa: सैन्यक्षयकरं चैव प्राणानां संशयावहम्। चक्रे तस्य हि साहाय्यं भगवान् हव्यवाहनः॥
en: It destroyed many soldiers, and it endangered the life (of the hero Sahadeva), for the lord, the carrier of sacrificial libation (fire), was helping him (the king Nila).

sa: नैके युगसलान्तास्त्वया दृष्टा महामुने। न चापीह समः कश्चिदायुष्मान् दृश्यते तव॥
en: "O great Rishi, you have seen many thousands of ages pass away. In this world there is none who is seen to be so long lived as you.

sa: न स्मराम्यनृतं किंचिन्न स्मराम्यपकारताम्। न च पर्युषितं वाक्यं स्वैरेष्वपि कदाचन॥
en: I do not remember a little untruth in him; neither I remember any injury committed by him to others, nor he ever told a lie even in jest.

sa: सुकन्यायाः पितुश्चास्य लोके कीर्तिः प्रथेदिति। अतो मयैतद् विहितं तव वीर्यप्रकाशनम्॥
en: My object was to spread the fame of the father of Sukanya all over the world. It has been done by me, so that your fame may spread.

sa: स गदा बहुधा दृष्ट्वा कृत्तां बाणैस्तरस्विना। संवृत्य विद्ययाऽऽत्मानं योधयामास पाण्डवम्॥
en: Seeing his mace cut into piece by that very active hero, (Arjuna), with his arrows, he with his own science (of illusion) began to fight with the Pandava.

sa: न क्षस्यन्ते तथास्माभिर्जातु विप्रकृता हि ते। द्रौपद्याश्च परिक्लेशं कस्तेषां क्षन्तुमर्हति॥
en: Persecuted (as) they are (by us), they cannot forgive us for those injuries. Who is there amongst them who will be able to forgive the insult to Draupadi?

sa: एवमुक्तो मनुर्मत्स्यमनयद् भगवान् वशी। नदीं गङ्गां तत्र चैनं स्वयं प्राक्षिपदच्युतः॥
en: Having been thus addressed, the up-right, continent and the adorable Manu took the fish to the river Ganga and put it into its water with his own hands.

sa: हा कृष्ण द्वारकावासिन् क्वासि संकर्षणानुज। कस्मान्न त्रायसे दुःखान्मां चेमांश्च नरोत्तमान्॥
en: O Krishna, O dweller of Dwarka, O younger brother of Sankarshana (Baladeva), where are you? Why do you not save me and these best of men (the Pandavas)?

sa: अन्तवत्यसुधर्मेऽस्मिन् धात्रा किं नु प्रमादतः। ममान्तो नैव विहितस्तेनायुर्न जहाति माम्॥
en: Everything possessing life is sure to perish. Has Dhatra (creator) forgotten to ordain my death? Perhaps it is so; and that is why life does not quit me.

sa: यदस्त्वयमिमं शश्वन्मोहात् संस्तौषि भक्तितः। कंशवं तच्च ते भीष्म न कश्चिदनुमन्यते॥
en: O Bhishma, there is none who approves your conduct in thus continually praising this Keshava, who is unworthy of any praise; you (surely) do it from ignorance alone.

sa: अहं केसरिणः क्षेत्रे वायुना जगदायुषा। जातः कमलपत्राक्ष हनूमान् नाम वानरः॥
en: O lotus eyed hero, I am born in the womb of Kesari, begotten by Vayu who is the life of the universe. I am the monkey, named Hanuman.

sa: उक्तस्योक्तस्य नेहान्तमहं समुपलक्षये। यत् तु वक्ष्यामि तत् सर्वं शृणुध्वं वसुधाधिपाः॥
en: Bhishma said O rulers of earth, I do not see the ends of our speeches, for words may be answered with words. Therefore, listen to what I say.

sa: अथ तैर्दानवैः सार्धं महिषस्त्रासयन् सुरान्। अभ्यद्रवद् रणे तूर्णं सिंहः क्षुद्रमृगानिव॥
en: This act of Mahisha struck terror into the hearts of the celestials. With other Danavas, he again attacked them as a lion attacks a herd of small deer.

sa: तस्य मां तनयां सर्वे जानीत द्विजसत्तमाः। निषधाधिपतिर्धीमान् नलो नाम महायशाः॥
en: The heroic, the ever-victorious (in battle), the learned lord of the Nishadhas, Nala by name, of illustrious fame, great intelligence and the ruler of men, is my husband.

sa: क्रियतां दर्शने यत्नो देवस्य परमेष्ठिनः। दर्शनात् तस्य कौन्तेय संसिद्धः स्वर्गमेष्यसि॥
en: O son of Kunti, try to meet the greatest of all gods, for it is only when you have seen him that you would have your desire fulfilled.”

sa: तवाभिगमनार्थं तु सर्वतो ब्राह्मणा गताः। वाक्यानि मम गाथाभिर्गायमाना दिशो दश॥
en: With a view to bring you here, the Brahmanas had gone away in all directions, (to the ten points of the horizon) singing my words, composed in ballads.

sa: वाक्यमप्रतिनन्दन्तं भर्तारमभिवीक्ष्य सा। दमयन्ती पुनर्वेश्म वीडिता प्रविवेश ह॥ निशम्य सततं चाक्षान् पुण्यश्लोकपराङ्मुखान्। नलं च हृतसर्वस्वंधात्री पुनरुवाच ह॥ बृहत्सेने पुनर्गच्छ वार्ष्णेयं नलशासनात्। सूतमानय कल्याणि महत् कार्यमुपस्थितम्॥
en: Damayanti, beholding that her lord uttered not a word to her in reply, felt shame and entered her own apartments. And also hearing that the virtuous Nala was always defeated at dice and deprived of all his possessions, she spoke again unto her nurse, Brihadsena! O blessed one do you go and summon, in the name of Nala, Varshneya, the charioteer, as a very serious matter is near at hand.

sa: यत् ते तदाऽऽसीत् प्लवतः सागरं मकरालयम्। रूपमप्रतिमं वीर तदिच्छामि निरीक्षितुम्॥
en: O hero, I desire to see your that matchless form which you had at the time when you jumped across the ocean, that abode of crocodiles and sharks.

sa: दण्डः संरक्षते धर्मं तथैवार्थ जनाधिप। कामं संरक्षते दण्डस्त्रिवर्गो दण्ड उच्यते॥
en: The rod of chastisement protects. Religion and Profit. It protects Pleasure also, O king! For this, the rod of chastisement is identified with the three-fold objects of life.

sa: सोऽब्रवीन्मातरं धीमान् वेपमानां कृताञ्जलिः॥ प्राप्तान् विषह्यांश्चतुरो न हनिष्यामि ते सुतान्।
en: The intelligent Karna, with joined palms then replied to his trembling mother, saying,-'If I get your four other sons even under my power, I will not kill them.

sa: तान् हत्वा निशितैर्वाणैः सामात्यान् सह बन्धुभिः। रथे श्वेतहये तिष्ठन्नर्जुनो बह्वशोभत॥
en: Having, with his sharp arrows, killed those troops with allies and relatives, Arjuna, as he stood on his car having white horses yoked to it, shone highly beautiful.

sa: अश्रान्तां चाविवर्णां च क्षुत्पिपासासमायुताम्। एवं सिद्धिः परा प्राप्ता अरुन्धत्या विशुद्धया॥
en: Indeed, the Rishis has been stricken with wonder on seeing the god and the chaste Arundhati herself as hale and hearty and capable of bearing hunger and thirst.

sa: पुत्रान् भ्रातृन् निगृह्णन्तो विनयन्तश्च तान् सदा। विनीतांश्च प्रगृह्णन्तो विवर्धन्ते गणोत्तमाः॥
en: By restraining their sons and brothers and instructing them in their duties, and treating all persons kindly whose pridc has been subdued by knowledge, the aristocracy grow prosperous.

sa: विश्वामित्रस्ततो राजनित्युक्तो भरतर्षभ। क्षुधातः प्रत्युवाचेदं पुनरेव महामुनिः॥ निराहारस्य सुमहान् मम कालोऽभिधावतः। न विद्यतेऽप्युपायश्च कश्चिन्मे प्राणधारणे॥
en: Thus addressed, O king, the great Rishi Vishvamitra, stricken with hunger, O foremost of Bharata's race, once more said,-A long time has passed away without my having taken any food, I do not see any means again for keeping up my life.

sa: शरैश्च विविधैरन्यैर्धक्ष्यते भूरितेजसम्। इति द्रोणं समाधाय शंसन्ति च रुदन्ति च॥
en: Having collected various other sorts of arrows, that highly energetic hero is being consumed by them. Having placed his body on the pyre, they are singing and weeping.

sa: पृथिवीं च सुवर्णं च रत्नानि विविधानि च। आभिषेचनिकं भाण्डं सर्वसम्भारसम्भृतम्॥
en: Then earth and gold, and many sorts of gems, and all other articles in profusion which were necessary for the performance of the coronation rite, were brought there.

sa: सर्वे क्षयान्ता निचयाः पतनान्ताः समुच्छ्रयाः। संयोगा विप्रयोगान्ता मरणान्तं च जीवितम्॥
en: Everything is liable to destruction; everything that is high is sure to fall down. Union is sure to end in separation; life is sure to end in death.

sa: सहानुजं जघानाशु वृत्रं देवपतिर्यथा। बिभेद क्रौञ्चं शक्त्या च पावकिः परवीरहा॥
en: The destroyer of hostile heroes, viz., Agni's son, pierced with his dart the Krauncha mountain, dividing his own-self sometimes into many and sometimes aggregating them all into one.

sa: कुर्वीत पितृदैवत्यं धर्माणि च समाचरेत्। यजेच्च विद्वान् विधिवत् त्रिवर्गं चाप्युपाचरेत्॥
en: One possessed of knowledge should perform the rites laid down for the Pitris and the gods, perforin all religious duties, celebrate sacrifices, judiciously pursue religion, profit and pleasure.

sa: दशधर्मतेभ्यो यद् वसु बह्वल्पमेव च। तदाददीत सहसा पौराणां रक्षणाय वै॥
en: He should also take away by force the wealth, much or little, of the ten sorts of offenders mentioned in the scriptures, for the protection of his subjects.

sa: दण्डेन रक्ष्यमाणा हि राजनहरहः प्रजाः। राजानं वर्धयन्तीह तस्माद् दण्डः परायणम्॥
en: O king, always protected by punishment, the subjects, increase the might of their ruler. It is for this that punishment is regarded as the highest refuge of all.

sa: सम्यग्दण्डधरो नित्यं राजा धर्ममवाप्नुयात्। नृपस्य सततं दण्डः सम्यग् धर्मः प्रशस्यते॥
en: The king, who always judiciously holds the rod of punishment, acquires great merit. The proper regulation of punishment is the great duty of kings and deserves great praise.

sa: रुतज्ञा सर्वभूतानां यथा वै जीवजीवकः। सर्वज्ञा सर्वतत्त्वज्ञा तिर्यग्योनिं गतापि सा॥
en: Like the bird Jivajivaka, Pujani could imitate the cries of all animals. Though a bird by birth, she had acquired great knowledge and was conversant with every truth.

sa: धर्मात्मा तात सर्वज्ञः पारावर्येण निर्णये। अमर्त्य इव मर्त्यः सन्नेष प्राणानधारयत्॥
en: Pious and acquainted with all forms of duty, by the help of his knowledge of both the worlds, that hero, though mortal, is still alive like an immortal.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो भूमौ स्थित्वा रथवरे स्थितम्॥ उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा द्रोणभीष्मसमं रणे।
en: Then Duryodhana, come down from his car, folded his hands and addressing Shalya, equal to Drona and Bhishma in battle, who was on his car, said these words.

sa: येन विस्पर्धसे नित्यं यदर्थं घटसेऽनिशम्। युध्यतस्तेन ते पाप भूमिश्चक्रं गृसिष्यति॥
en: While fighting him, O wretch, whom you always challenge, and for whom you are trying so much every day, the Earth shall swallow the wheel of your car.

sa: अपि तु त्वां मृदुप्रज्ञमत्यार्यमतिधार्मिकम्। क्लीबं धर्मघृणायुक्तं न लोको बहु मन्यते॥
en: Your heart is mild by nature, you are merciful, and highly righteous. You are without energy, are virtuous and full of compassion. People, however, do not respect you.

sa: अल्पावशिष्टे सैन्येऽस्मिन् सूतपुत्रे च पातिते। सपुत्रे वै नरव्याघ्र नैवाशाम्यत वैशसम्॥
en: Even, when a residue only of the Kaurava army remained after the fall of that best of men, viz., Karna, with his sons the battle did not stop.

sa: प्रसुप्तानां वधं श्रुत्वा द्रौणिना पापकर्मणा। शोकस्तपति मां पार्थ हुताशन इवाश्रयम्॥
en: O son of Pritha, hearing of the slaughter of those sleeping heroes by Drona's sinful son, grief burns me as if I were in the midst of fire.

sa: तस्मादन्यत्र यास्यामि वस्तुं नाहमिहोत्सहे। दृतमेतदनार्यं मे तव पुत्रे च पार्थिव॥
en: I shall, therefore, repair to some other region. I do not venture to live any longer in this place, for I have greatly injured your child, O king.

sa: ततो विधनुषं देवा देवश्रेष्ठमुपागमन्। शरणं सह यज्ञेन प्रसादं चाकरोत् प्रभुः॥
en: The gods then came to the god of gods, and, with the embodied form of Sacrifice, sought the protection of the powerful Mahadeva and tried to please him.

sa: एवमुक्तः परां शान्ति मारिण स मूषिकः। उवाच परमन्त्रज्ञः श्लक्ष्णमात्महितं वचः॥
en: Accosted thus with sweet words by the cat, the mouse, who knew all which produces the highest good, replied in these sweet words that were beneficial to himself.

sa: शीतमुष्णं तथा वर्ष कालेन परिवर्तते। एवमेव मनुष्याणां सुखदुः :खे नरर्षभ॥
en: Cold, and heat, and rain, come in turn in course of Time. Such is the case, O foremost of men, with the happiness and the misery of mankind.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः कल्यं समुत्थाय कृतपूर्वाह्निकक्रियाः। ययुस्ते नगराकारै रथैः पाण्डवयादवाः॥
en: Rising from their beds the next day and performing morning rites laid down in the scriptures, the Pandavas and the Yadavas started on their cars resembling fortified towns.

sa: स सुनाभं सहस्रारं वज्रनाभमयस्मयम्। ववे चक्रं महाभागो मत्तः स्पर्धन्मया सह॥
en: Thus addressed, the illustrious son of Drona, as if challenging me, wanted my discus of excellent have and hard as thunder, having thousand spokes, and made of iron.

sa: यच्छक्नोषि समुद्यन्तुं प्रयोक्तुमपि वा रणे। तद् गृहाण विनास्त्रेण यन्मे दातुमभीप्सति॥
en: Without giving me the weapon you wish to give, take from among these weapons of mine that which you will be able to wield and use in battle.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाराज प्राविशत् तं महाह्रदम्। अस्तम्भयत तोयं च मायया मनुजाधिपः॥
en: Saying this to me, O king, the king, entered that lake. By his power of illusion king Duryodhana charmed the waters of the lake, making room for him.

sa: कुलजः प्राकृतो राज्ञा स्वकुलीनतया सदा। न पापे कुरुते बुद्धि भिद्यमानोऽप्यनागसि॥
en: Even if persecuted without any fault by his master, a person of high birth never thinks of, in consequence of the respectability of his blood, injuring his master.

sa: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु कृतवीर्यात्मजो बली। अर्जुनो नाम तेजस्वी क्षत्रियो हैहयाधिपः॥ दत्तात्रेयप्रसादेन राजा बाहुसहस्रवान्। चक्रवर्ती महातेजा विप्राणामाश्वमेधिके॥ ददौ स पृथिवीं सर्वां सप्तद्वीपां सपर्वताम्। स्वबाह्वस्त्रबलेनाजौ जित्वा परमधर्मवित्॥
en: Meanwhile the powerful son of Kritavirya, the king of the Haihayas, endued with great power, highly pious, and possessed of a on thousand arms through the favour of the great Rishi) Dattatreya, having conquered in battle, by the strength of his own arms, the entire Earth with her mountains and seven islands, became a very powerful sovereign and (at iast) gave away the Earth to the Brahmanas in a house-sacrifice.

sa: निपानं सर्वभूतानां भूत्वा त्वं पावनं महत्। आढ्यो वनस्पतिर्भूत्वा सोऽन्यांस्त्वं पर्युपाससे॥
en: Having been, like a large and sacred lake to all creatures, having been a mighty tree worthy of adoration, alas, how can you wait upon and adore others?

sa: सत्यसेनस्य च धनुर्हस्तावापं च मारिष॥ चिच्छेद तरसा युद्धे तत उच्चुक्रुशुर्जनाः।
en: Without losing a moment, he then cut off the boy and the leathern fence of Saryasena also, at which all the troops there sent up a loud shout.

sa: यमाबध्य भयं नास्ति शस्त्रव्याधिक्षुधाश्रयम्। देवेभ्यो दानवेभ्यो वा नागेभ्यो वा कथंचन॥
en: Whenever this gem is used, the wearer entertains no fear from weapons or discase or hunger. He ceases to have any fear of celestials and Danavas and Nagas.

sa: कर्मणा येन तेनैव मृदुना दारुणेन च। उद्धरेद् दीनमात्मानं समर्थो धर्ममाचरेत्॥
en: When one is in distress, he should raise himself by any means in his power. mild or stern; and after such advancement, he should, if able, practise virtue.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच शिवान् सुखान् महोदर्कानहिंस्त्राल्लोकसम्मतान्। ब्रूहि धर्मान् सुखोपायान् मद्विधानां सुखावहान्॥
en: Yudhishthira said Tell us those duties which persons like ourselves should follow and which are auspicious, yield happiness in the future, benevolent, applauded by all, pleasant, and agreeable.

sa: ते तस्य राज्ञो वचनं सम्प्रगृह्य तपोधनाः। ऋषयो राजशार्दूलं तमपृच्छन् प्रयोजनम्॥
en: Duly answering the questions of the king, those Rishis having asceticism for wealth, asked that foremost of kings as to the cause of his coming to that retreat.

sa: आपद्येव त याचन्ते येषां नास्ति परिग्रहः। दातव्यं धर्मतस्तेभ्यस्त्वनुक्रोशाद् भयान तु॥
en: They who do not live upon alms may beg at the time of distress. The righteous king should make gifts to them from mercy but not from fear.

sa: द्रौपद्या राजपुत्र्याश्च प्रव्राजनं च नगरादजिनैश्च विवासनम्। महारण्यनिवासश्च न तस्य स्मर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Why do you not remember our expulsion from the (Kuru) city and our exile (into the forest clad in deer-skins, as also our, living in the great forests?

sa: नैतौ सम्भवतो राजन् कथंचिदपि पार्थिवा न हरण्येषु पश्यामि धनवृद्धानहं क्वचित्॥
en: The acquisition of wealth and its abandonment cannot both be possibly suen in the same individual, O king. I do not see a rich man in the forest.

sa: स कथं कौरवे वंशे प्रशंसञ्जन्म चात्मनः। युद्धाद् भीतस्ततस्तोयं प्रविश्य प्रतितिष्ठसि॥
en: How do you boast of your birth in Kuru's family, when you have concealed yourself within the depths of this lake, having fled away from battle in fear?

sa: पृष्टश्च तेन बहुशः प्राप्तं कथमनुत्तमम्। त्रैलोक्यराज्यं धर्मज्ञ कारणं तद् ब्रवीहि मे। प्रह्लादोऽपि महाराज ब्राह्मणं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Many a time the Brahmana enquired, saying,O chastiser of enemies by what means have you been able to acquire the sovereignty of the three worlds? Tell me, O pious king, what those means are!-Prahlada, O king, answered the question of the Brahmana.

sa: एष चार्थो महाबाहो पूर्वमेव मया श्रुतः। कथितो धर्मराजस्य राजसूये ऋतूत्तमे॥
en: O you, of mighty-arms, I had learnt all this sometime before. I also spoke of it to king Yudhishthira the just at the time of the Rajasuya sacrifice.

sa: त्वया सृष्टमिदं विश्वं वदन्तीह मनीषिणः। त्वामेव सर्वं व्रजति पुनरेव युगक्षये॥
en: O wielder of the trident, thou art the refuge of this universe consisting of gods and demons. The wise say that this universe has been created by you.

sa: वेगेन त्वरिता जग्मुर्हरयः शीघ्रगामिनः। शिविरात् स्वाद् गृहीत्वा स रथस्य पदमच्युतः॥
en: Brave and energetic as he was, Bhima started from the Pandava camp and proceeded quickly along the track of Ashvatthaman's car." quickly along the track of Ashvatthaman's car."

sa: न हि मद्राधिपादन्यो रामाद् वा यदुनन्दनात्। सोढुमुत्सहते वेगं भीमसेनस्य संयुगे॥
en: Except the ruler of the Madras or Rama, that delighter of the Yadus, there is none else that can venture to stand the impetuosity of Bhima in battle.

sa: भीष्म उवाच राजवृत्तं महाराज शृणुष्वावहितोऽखिलम्। यत् कार्यं पार्थिवेनादौ पार्थिवप्रकृतेन वा॥
en: Bhishma said 'Listen, O king, with attention to the various duties of kings,-to those acts which the king or one who is in his position should first do.

sa: हतप्रवीरा विध्वस्ता निकृता निशितैः शरैः। सूतपुत्रे हते राजन् पुत्रास्ते दुद्रुबुर्भयात्॥
en: Having the beast of their heroes killed, their soldiers all routed and themselves sounded with sharp arrows your sons, on the fall of Karna, fled away in fear.

sa: स सायकः कर्णभुजप्रसृष्टो हुताशनार्कप्रतिमो महार्हः। महोरगः कृतवैरोऽर्जुनेन किरीटमाहत्य ततो व्यतीयात्॥
en: Crushing down his crown that precious arrows, effulgent like the sun or fire, shot by Karna, the great serpent, who was rendered by Arjuna his enemy, went away.

sa: अकस्मात् क्रोधमोहाभ्यां लोभाद् वापि स्वभावजात्।। अन्योन्यं नाभिभाषन्ते तत्पराभवलक्षणम्। जात्या च सदृशाः सर्वे कुलेन सदृशास्तथा॥ न चोद्योगेन बुद्ध्या वा रूपद्रव्येण वा पुनः। तस्मात् संघातमेबाहुर्गणानां शरणं महत्॥
en: Persons who are equal in family and blood, under the influence of anger, folly and covetousness cease to speak with one another. This is an indication of defeat. It is not by courage, nor intelligence, nor by beauty, nor by riding, that enemies can destroy the aristocracy. It is only by disunion and gifts that it can be brought to subjugation. Therefore, union is the greatest refuge of the aristocracy.

sa: तेन धर्मोत्तस्थायं कृतो लोको महात्मना। रंजिताश्च प्रजाः सर्वास्तेन राजेति शब्द्यते॥
en: That great king caused all creatures to consider righteousness as the foremost of all things; and because he pleased all the people, therefore, he was called Rajan (king.)

sa: कपिलानां सवत्सानां वर्षमेकं निरन्तरम्। यो दद्यात् सुकृतं तद्धि श्रवणात् कर्णपर्वणः॥
en: The merit acquired by listening to the recitation of this Parvan is tantamount to what is obtained by giving away good kine with calves incessantly for a year.

sa: ततस्तेन तपःशक्त्या विदितो ज्ञानचक्षुषा॥ विज्ञाय स महाप्राज्ञो मुनिः श्वानं तमुक्तवान्।
en: The latter saw it all by his spiritual vision and ascetic power. Highly wise the sage, having learnt the object of the beast spoke to him these words.

sa: बाणशब्दरवान् कृत्वा विमिश्राशङ्खनिःस्वनैः॥ अस्मांस्तु पुनरासाद्य लब्धलक्ष्यप्रहारिणः। शरासनानि धुन्वानाः सिंहनादान् प्रचुक्रुशुः॥
en: Shooting their arrows and making various other kinds of noise mingled with the blare of their conchs, those warriors of sure aim, shook bows and uttered leonine shouts.

sa: अहिंसाय भूतानां धर्मप्रवचनं कृतम्। यः स्यादहिंसासम्पृक्तः स धर्म इति निश्चयः॥
en: Righteousness is also so called because it maintains all creatures. In fact, all creatures are kept up Righteousness, Therefore, Righteousness is what is capable of upholding all creatures.

sa: निकृत्या निकृता नित्यं धृतराष्ट्रसुतैर्वयम्। बहूनि परुषाण्युक्त्वा वनं प्रस्थापिताः स्म ह॥
en: By gujle were we always imposed on by the sons of Dhritarastra! They spoke many harsh words to us. We were again exiled into the forest by them.

sa: ततस्ते मुनयः सर्वे परिवार्य नरर्षभम्। उपाविशन् नरव्याघ्र सप्तर्षय इव ध्रुवम्॥
en: Then all the ascetics, O. foremost of kings, sat there, encircling that foremost of men like the stars of the constellation of Ursa Major surrounding the Pole star.

sa: प्रतिव्यूह्य बलं सर्वं रणमध्ये व्यवस्थितः। एनं हत्वा शितैर्बाणैः कृतकृत्यो भविष्यसि॥
en: Having re-arranged the remnant of his army, he waits in the midst of his forces. Killing this one with your keen arrows you may achieve all your objects.

sa: आशायास्तपसि श्रेष्ठास्तथा नान्तमहं गतः। भवतां विदितं सर्वं सर्वज्ञा हि तपोधनाः॥
en: Oh ye ascetics, likewise, I also cannot make out the limit of hope. With penances you have made yourselves omniscient. There is nothing which is hidden from you.

sa: नाच्छित्त्वा परमर्माणि नाकृत्वा कर्म दुष्करम्। नाहत्वा मत्स्यघातीव प्राणोति महतीं श्रियम्॥
en: Without cutting the vital parts of others, without performing the most difficult deeds, and without killing creatures like a fisherman (slaying fish), no person can acquire great prosperity.

sa: विदित्वा भक्तियोगं तु भीष्मस्य पुरुषोत्त्मः। सहसोत्थाय संहृष्टो यानमेवान्वपद्यत॥ केशवः सात्यकिश्चापि रथेनैकेन जग्मतुः। अपरेण महात्मानौ युधिष्ठिरधंजयौ॥
en: Learning of the devotion of Bhishma towards him, that foremost of Beings, viz., Madhava, suddenly rose from his seat and got on his car, Keshava and Satyaki proceeded on one car. On another proceeded those two great princess, viz., Yudhishthira and Dhananjaya.

sa: किमन्यत् कालयोगाद्धि दिष्टमेव परायणम्॥ मा च दोषान् महाप्राज्ञ पाण्डवेषु निवेशय।
en: What else can it be but the effect of Time? Indeed, Destiny always reigns supreme! Do not, O you of great wisdom, attribute any fault to the Pandavas.

sa: इति कृत्यसमुद्देशः कीर्तितस्ते मयानघ। तरन्ते येन दुर्गाणि परत्रेह च मानवाः॥
en: I have now, O sinless one, described to you all those acts by which men may get over all difficulties both in this world and in the next.

sa: कृश उवाच दुर्लभोऽप्यथवा नास्ति योऽर्थी धृतिमवाप्नुयात्। स दुर्लभतरस्तात योऽर्थिनं नावमन्यते॥
en: It highly difficult to find a contented applicant. Perhaps, there is none such in the world. Still rare, O sire, is the man who never disregards an applicant.
